articles.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
articles.content: We present 4DAnyone, a framework for reconstructing 4D humans from an uncalibrated monocular video by generating reconstruction-grade multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS). Existing camera-controlled video diffusion models synthesize plausible novel-view videos but fail to maintain consistency when scaled to the tens of target views required for 4DGS reconstruction. We identify this failure as a bounded-attention-context problem: when target views exceed the capacity of a single DiT forward pass, they must be split into groups, exposing two coupled bottlenecks. On the reference-context side, conditioning on all previously generated views grows as $O(N)$, weakening cross-view appearance guidance. On the target-context side, disjoint groups cannot directly exchange information, causing global structural drift. 4DAnyone addresses both bottlenecks with two complementary designs: Reference Context Packing (RCP) compresses growing reference views into a fixed-length mixed-resolution context with $O(1)$ reference-context complexity, while Target Context Routing (TCR) rotates target-view groupings during denoising to share context across groups at high-noise steps and stabilize details at low-noise steps. We further build the MVGameHuman dataset using our in-house game engine and combine it with light-stage and in-the-wild video datasets for training. Experiments on DNA-Rendering and DyMVHumans show that 4DAnyone outperforms prior methods in both novel-view video quality and downstream 4DGS reconstruction, with robust in-the-wild generalization. See our project page for video results and source code: https://4danyone.github.io.

articles.title_zh: 4D任何人: 从临时单曲视频创建 4D 中的任何人
articles.content_zh: 我们提出4DAnyone, 一个重建4D人类的框架, 现有摄像头控制的视频传播模型合成了可信的新颖视图视频,但当缩放到4DGS重建所需的数十个目标视图时却未能保持一致性. 我们认为,这一失败是一个有限度的意向问题:当目标观点超过一个DiT前进通道的能力时,必须将其分成几组,暴露出两个相互关联的瓶颈。 在参考文本方面,对所有先前生成的视图的限制随着$O(N)美元的增长而增加,削弱了交叉视图的外观指导。 在目标文字方面,脱节团体不能直接交换信息,导致全球结构漂移。 4D任何人用两种互补设计来解决这两个瓶颈: 参考背景包装(RCP)将不断增长的参考视图压缩成具有$O(1)$参考背景复杂性的固定长度混合分辨率上下文,而目标背景搜索(TCR)则在解密时旋转目标视图分组,在高噪音步骤下在各组之间共享上下文,在低噪音步骤下稳定细节. 我们利用我们内部的游戏引擎进一步构建MVGame Human数据集,并将其与灯光舞台和闪闪发光的视频数据集结合进行训练. 关于DNA渲染和DyMV Humans的实验显示,4DAnyone在小说视觉视频质量和下游4DGS重建中都超越了前作方法,并具有强力的万事通. 视频结果和源代码见我们的项目网页:https://4danyone.github.io。

articles.title: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
articles.content: Identity-preserving image generation becomes increasingly unreliable when a scene must contain many specified people. Beyond retaining each identity, the model must bind every reference to a distinct person and location, while training-time identity losses must establish correspondence among several noisy predicted faces. We introduce WithEveryone, a unified framework for generating group images up to ten reference identities. WithEveryone injects each selected identity as an addressed token, predicts a structured identity--layout plan, and renders the plan as a visual condition. Its key objective, Layout-Grounded ID Loss, uses annotated face regions to supervise the intended identities directly, avoiding unstable embedding-based face matching; ID Representation Forcing additionally trains a prediction for each identity before image synthesis. On an identity-disjoint benchmark, WithEveryone achieves the highest target-context identity similarity, improving face similarity from 0.462 for GPT-Image-2 to 0.499, while reducing copy-paste artifacts from 0.169 to 0.055. It further covers 97.3\% of the requested identities with a duplicate rate of only 2.8\%. These results show that explicit identity--layout grounding enables identity-preserving generation to scale to larger groups without relying on direct reference-face copying.

articles.title_zh: With everyone: 组合图像生成的统一规划和身份定位
articles.content_zh: 当一个场景必须包含许多特定的人时,保存身份的图像生成就变得越来越不可靠. 除了保留每个身份之外,该模式还必须将每一处提及不同的人和地点的内容都联系在一起,而培训时间身份损失则必须确定几个吵闹的预测面孔之间的对应关系。 我们引入了With Everyone,一个生成最多10个参考身份的群体图像的统一框架. 每个人将每个选定的身份作为地址符号注入,预测一个结构化的身份放出计划,并将计划作为视觉条件. 它的关键目标——布局-Grounded ID Loss,使用注解面部区域来直接监督预期身份,避免不稳定的嵌入式面部匹配;ID 代理附加在图像合成之前对每个身份进行预测. 在身份不关联的基准上,"With Everyone"实现最高目标-背景身份相似性,将面部相似性从GPT-Image-2的0.462提高到0.499,同时将复制版文物从0.169减少到0.055. 它还涵盖97.3+%所要求的身份,重复率仅为2.8+%。 这些结果表明,明确的身份划分基础使身份保留生成能够向更大的群体推广,而不依赖于直接的参考面复制。

articles.title: Swift-Image: Exploring the Performance Frontier of Compact Unified Image Generation Models
articles.content: We present Swift-Image, a compact unified model for text-to-image generation, single-image editing, and multi-image editing. Our goal is to explore how far a relatively small visual generator can be pushed through systematic training engineering under a constrained computational budget. Swift-Image adopts an efficient 6B single-stream DiT and a progressive training pipeline that evolves from broad semantic coverage to higher resolution, stronger visual quality, and unified generation-editing supervision. For post-training, we employ parallel expert reinforcement learning followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation to alleviate interference among heterogeneous objectives. We further decouple high-level reasoning from pixel-level rendering with a Prompt Enhancer that translates user requests into generator-aligned visual specifications. For efficient deployment, structural pruning and few-step distillation produce 3B and accelerated variants. Swift-Image achieves leading aggregate performance among evaluated open-source models with only 6B parameters and 243K GPU training hours; the compressed 3B model incurs nearly no loss, while few-step distillation further improves aggregate editing performance with substantially fewer sampling steps. Our study also summarizes practical lessons for architecture, data curriculum, post-training, prompt enhancement, and model compression.

articles.title_zh: Swift-Image:探索契约统一图像生成模型的性能前沿
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍Swift-Image,一个紧凑的文本到图像生成,单图像编辑,多图像编辑的统一模型. 我们的目标是探索在有限的计算预算下,通过系统培训工程,一个相对较小的视觉发电机可以推进到什么程度. Swift-Image采用高效的6B单流DiT和渐进式培训管道,从广义语义覆盖到更高的分辨率,更高的视觉质量,以及统一的生成编辑监督. 在培训后,我们采用平行的专家强化学习,然后是多教师的政策提炼,以减轻不同目标之间的干扰。 我们进一步将高层次的推理与像素级渲染脱钩,并配以一个将用户请求转换成生成器相通的视觉规格的快速增强器. 为了高效的部署,结构挤压和几步蒸馏产生3B和加速变体. Swift-Image在只有6B参数和243K GPU训练时数的被评价开源模型中实现了领先的聚合性能;压缩的3B模型几乎不发生损失,而几步蒸馏则以少得多的采样步骤进一步改善集合编辑性能. 我们的研究还总结了建筑、数据课程、培训后、迅速增强和模型压缩等方面的实际经验教训。

articles.title: G-CARL: Grounded Checklist-Aligned Reward Learning for Patient-Oriented Medical Report Interpretation
articles.content: Personalized interpretation of medical reports has emerged as an increasingly important need among patients. Addressing this need requires both evidence-grounded medical factuality and context-dependent patient communication, yet existing medical vision-language tasks do not adequately capture these dual requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce Patient-oriented Medical Report Interpretation (PMRI), a novel open-ended multimodal generation task that requires models to explain medical reports in accurate and accessible language based on a user's query and dialogue history. These two objectives differ fundamentally in their verifiability, yet remain tightly coupled, making them difficult to optimize jointly under conventional supervised fine-tuning and holistic reinforcement learning paradigms. To address this challenge, we propose G-CARL, a grounded, checklist-aligned reinforcement learning framework that combines multi-source retrieval for atomic claim verification with context-aware, instance-specific weighted checklists for response coverage, providing structured supervision for factuality, user-demand satisfaction, and expression quality without constraining response diversity. We further construct MMedReport, a real-world PMRI benchmark, along with a clinician-designed three-dimensional evaluation protocol. Extensive experiments demonstrate that G-CARL consistently outperforms existing post-training baselines in overall quality, claim-level precision, and checklist recall. Pairwise preference evaluation by clinicians further confirms that G-CARL produces interpretations that are more accurate and better aligned with patient needs.

articles.title_zh: G-CARL:有底牌的核对表 -- -- 以病人为对象的医学报告解释
articles.content_zh: 对医疗报告进行个性化解释已成为病人日益重要的需要。 满足这一需要需要既需要循证的医疗实况,也需要视具体情况而定的病人沟通,但现有的医疗视觉语言任务并没有充分反映这些双重要求。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了面向病人的医学报告解释(PMRI),这是一项新型的开放式多式联运生成任务,需要模型根据用户的查询和对话历史,以准确和方便的语言解释医学报告. 这两个目标在可核查性方面有着根本的不同,但仍然紧密结合,难以在常规监督的微调和整体强化学习模式下共同优化。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议建立G-CARL,这是一个有根据的、与清单相一致的强化学习框架,将多源检索用于原子权利主张核查与了解具体情况相结合,具体实例的加权清单用于应对范围,对事实质量、用户需求满意度和表达质量提供结构化监督,同时又不限制应对的多样性。 我们进一步构建了MMED报告,这是一个现实世界的PMRI基准,以及临床医生设计的三维评价协议。 广泛的实验表明,G-CARL在总体质量、索赔水平精确度和核对表召回方面一贯超过现有的培训后基线。 临床医生的对等偏好评价进一步证实,G-CARL产生的解释更准确,更符合病人的需要.

articles.title: Inter-X++: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Human-Human Interaction Analysis
articles.content: The capability to perceive and synthesize human-human interactions is fundamental to developing intelligent digital human systems. However, existing datasets and modeling approaches are fundamentally constrained by low-fidelity kinematics, the omission of dexterous hand gestures and a severe lack of rich multimodal annotations. Furthermore, fragmented interaction representations and inconsistent evaluation protocols also impede fair and rigorous benchmarking. To systematically address these bottlenecks, we present Inter-X++, a comprehensive and large-scale benchmark designed to empower versatile HHI analysis. Captured via a novel hybrid motion capture system, Inter-X++ provides 11,388 high-fidelity interaction sequences and over 8.1M frames, featuring precise whole-body movements and detailed finger articulations. Meanwhile, we enrich the data foundation with multifaceted annotations, including hierarchical fine-grained textual descriptions, interaction categories, causal interaction orders, the relationship and personality of the subjects, as well as vertex-level contact maps and physically regularized constraints. Leveraging these elaborate annotations, we formulate a unified testing ground comprising four categories of downstream tasks that symmetrically span both generative and perceptive paradigms. To eliminate benchmarking ambiguities, we systematically standardize the interaction representations and evaluation protocols. Finally, we go beyond dataset construction to propose OpenHHI, a single and unified HHI representation and modeling framework that jointly optimizes interaction reconstruction and semantic understanding. Extensive experiments reveal that OpenHHI achieves state-of-the-art performance on both generation and perception tasks. This definitively proves that our unified representation successfully bridges interaction understanding and generation simultaneously.

articles.title: DreamHand: Repurposing Video Diffusion Models for Occlusion-Robust Egocentric 3D Hand Motion Recovery
articles.content: Egocentric video offers scalable manipulation data for embodied AI, yet recovering metric 3D hand trajectories remains challenging due to severe object occlusion and frequent out-of-sight gaps. Existing single-frame and windowed temporal regressors fail when hand shortly leaves the frame, while recent video diffusion models (VDMs) rely on heavy, stochastic multi-step sampling as pixel-space renderers. We instead repurpose VDM into a deterministic geometry encoder. A single forward pass over the clean latent exposes scene content beyond current observations, including occluded and out-of-sight hands. We introduce DreamHand, an offline clip-level framework that extracts features via a Deterministic Clean-Latent Encoder and decodes them with a Bidirectional Spatiotemporal Decoder. DreamHand recovers continuous bimanual trajectories with metric placement and no external detector, while a Ray-Based Camera Solver supports a second configuration that needs no test-time camera intrinsics. Across five egocentric benchmarks, DreamHand sets a new state of the art, cutting MPJPE-p by 30% on occlusion-heavy ARCTIC and 40% on HOT3D. These gains reach 46%-61% once out-of-sight hands are included in the evaluation, offering a scalable path from everyday human video to robot manipulation data.

articles.title: CalcSeg: Confidence-aware 3D Latent Context Curriculum Learning For Myocardial Scar Segmentation From Single-Stack LGE-CMRs
articles.content: Myocardial scar segmentation from single-stack late gadolinium-enhanced cardiac magnetic resonance (LGE-CMR) imaging has been a longstanding and clinically important challenge, particularly in the presence of low tissue contrast, diffuse, and small scar regions. These challenges are further intensified by the limited availability of 3D spatial context. This paper presents CalcSeg, a Confidence-aware latent context curriculum learning framework that leverages fused 3D feature representations from single-stack 2D LGE-CMR images for robust scar segmentation. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic semi-supervised curriculum learning strategy that progressively expands training from easier to more challenging scar cases using a learned confidence-aware scoring function. Such a function integrates errors in the predicted scar maps with quantified epistemic uncertainty and scar burden estimation to automatically assess sample difficulty without requiring manual labels. To compensate for the limited spatial context in single-stack acquisitions, we then develop a latent slice-wise self-attention to capture inter-slice dependencies and infer 3D spatial representations from sparse 2D inputs. We evaluate CalcSeg on multi-center clinical LGE-CMR datasets and benchmark against existing scar segmentation networks. Experimental results show that CalcSeg consistently outperforms all competing methods, particularly with substantial improvements on clinically challenging cases. Our code is released on Github.

articles.content_zh: 单层后期加多利铀增强心电磁共振成像(LGE-CMR)的心肌疤分化一直是长期和临床上重要的挑战,特别是在组织对比度低、扩散和小疤区存在的情况下。 由于3D空间环境有限,这些挑战进一步加剧。 本文介绍了CalcSeg,这是一个具有信心意识的潜在背景课程学习框架,利用从单层2D LGE-CMR图像中提取的3D功能表达,实现坚固的疤痕分解。 具体地说,我们采用了动态的半监督课程学习战略,将培训从比较容易的病例逐步扩大到比较具有挑战性的伤疤病例,同时利用已学到的自信评分功能。 这种功能将预测的疤痕图中的误差与量化的认知不确定性和疤痕负担估计结合起来,以自动评估样本难度,而不需要人工标签. 为了补偿单层收购中空间环境有限的情况,我们发展了潜在的切片自觉,以捕捉切片之间的依赖性,并推断出稀少的2D输入的3D空间表示. 我们以多中心临床LGE-CMR数据集和现有疤痕分解网络的基准评价CalcSeg。 实验结果显示,CalcSeg一直比所有相互竞争的方法都要好,特别是在临床挑战性病例方面有了实质性改进。 我们的密码在Github上发布

articles.title: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
articles.content: Reliable surgical planning requires models to anticipate not only how instruments will move, but also how the operative visual state will evolve together with such motion. Existing approaches typically treat future scene generation and instrument trajectory prediction as two separate tasks. Scene-only models cannot directly evaluate the accuracy of future instrument motion at the trajectory level, while trajectory-only models fail to capture the visual consequences of instrument movement, leaving the consistency between predicted trajectories and future scene evolution unaddressed. Jointly forecasting both provides a more complete account of surgical action-scene dynamics by enabling explicit trajectory-level evaluation while simultaneously modeling the corresponding visual evolution. To bridge this gap, we present a preliminary joint visual-trajectory world-action model that simultaneously forecasts future visual states and instrument trajectories from historical surgical observations. Specifically, we encode historical video frames and tool trajectories into latent representations, which are processed by a temporal-spatial encoder and subsequently decoded through separate visual-state and trajectory prediction heads. Based on this preliminary architecture, a chunked autoregressive rollout is repeatedly applied to predict fifteen future steps. The chunked strategy consistently outperforms direct one-shot prediction across all evaluated horizons, improving first-segment PSNR from 18.86 to 23.11 dB and reducing ADE from 45.77 to 22.22 pixels. These results demonstrate the initial feasibility of joint visual-motion forecasting. However, we observe progressive visual degradation and accumulated trajectory errors over longer prediction horizons, which remain important challenges for future surgical world-action modeling.

articles.title_zh: 朝向外科世界行动模式:外科运动规划的初步视觉-地形联合预测
articles.content_zh: 可靠的外科手术规划要求模型不仅预测仪器会如何移动,而且预测操作视觉状态会如何与这种运动一起演化. 现有方法通常将未来的场景生成和仪器轨迹预测作为两个不同的任务. 唯景模型无法直接评价轨迹层面未来仪器运动的精度,而仅轨迹模型无法捕捉到仪器运动的视觉后果,使得预测的轨迹与未来场景演化之间的一致性得不到处理. 联合预测两者都提供了更完整的外科手术动作-场景动态说明,既可以进行明确的轨迹级评价,同时又可以模拟相应的视觉演化. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了初步的视觉-弹射世界-行动联合模型,同时通过历史外科观测预测未来的视觉状态和仪器轨迹. 具体地说,我们把历史的视频帧和工具轨迹编码成潜伏的表达方式,这些表达方式由时间空间编码器处理,然后通过单独的视觉状态和轨迹预测头解码. 基于这一初步结构,多次采用块状的自递式推出来预测未来的15个步骤。 块状战略的绩效始终高于所有评价地平线的一弹一弹直射预测,将一级PSNR从18.86提高到23.11 dB,并将ADE从45.77像素降低到22.22像素. 这些结果显示了联合视觉-运动预报的初步可行性. 然而,我们看到视觉逐渐退化,在较长的预测范围上积累了轨迹错误,这仍然是未来手术世界行动模型的重要挑战。

articles.title: Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention for Hierarchical Feature Modulation toward Anatomy-Agnostic Segmentation
articles.content: Anatomically plausible segmentation remains challenging because of low contrast, ambiguous boundaries, and modality-specific artifacts. Interactive segmentation has emerged as a promising strategy to guide feature extraction and improve localization, particularly in structurally ambiguous regions. However, existing methods integrate prompts through late-stage fusion and lack explicit mechanisms for prompt-driven channel-wise modulation across hierarchical feature representations, limiting their ability to capture deeper contextual and modality-specific variations. To address these limitations, we introduce Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention (PCCA), a novel modulation mechanism that enables deep, hierarchical integration of semantic prompts within encoder-decoder networks. PCCA extracts compact channel descriptors via pooling, projects them into a shared space, and fuses them through a gated excitation mechanism to compute prompt-aware channel attention weights. These weights adaptively recalibrate feature responses across multiple network stages, enabling prompt-conditioned, semantically enriched hierarchical representations. Building on this, we propose PROMISE-Net, instantiated in two network variants: a convolutional model (PROMISE-CNN) and a transformer-based model (PROMISE-Txformer). Across the ISIC-Lesion, Kvasir-Polyp, CAMUS-Cardiac, and Kvasir-Instrument benchmarks, integrating PCCA into PROMISE-CNN yielded relative IoU gains of 10.4%, 8.7%, 0.8%, and 3.4%, respectively, over the baseline U-Net, while PROMISE-Txformer achieved corresponding gains of 7.6%, 23.0%, 2.1%, and 1.1%, respectively, over the baseline UNETR. These results show consistent improvements across architectures, imaging modalities, and anatomical targets, establishing PCCA and PROMISE-Net as a scalable, generalizable framework for prompt-aware hierarchical feature modulation in medical image segmentation.

articles.title_zh: 快速状态 向解剖学-不可知分解的分解方向分解的分解
articles.content_zh: 由于对比度低、界限模糊和特定模式的文物,在解剖学上看似合理的分割仍然具有挑战性。 互动分裂已成为指导特征提取和改进本地化的有希望的战略,特别是在结构模糊的区域。 然而,现有方法通过后期聚变整合了提示,缺乏跨等级特征表述的快速驱动通道调制的明确机制,限制了它们捕捉更深层次和特定模式差异的能力. 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了即时-有条件的通道注意(PCCA),这是一种新颖的调制机制,能够使语义的提示在编码器-解码器网络中进行深层次的整合. PCCA通过集合来提取紧凑的通道描述符,将其投射到共享空间中,并通过一个有门的激发机制将它们熔化,以计算出即时意识的通道注意力重量. 这些权重在多个网络阶段适应性地重新调整,从而能够迅速、精益求精地体现等级。 在此基础上,我们提出PROMISE-Net,以两个网络变体即时化:一个变体模型(PROMISE-CNN)和一个变体模型(PROMISE-Txformer). 在整个国际标准行业分类-Lesion、Kvasir-Polyp、CAMUS-Cardiac和Kvasir-Instruments基准中,将化学和化学工业分类纳入PROMISE-CNN后,与基线U-Net相比,IoU的相对收益分别为10.4%、8.7%、0.8%和3.4%,而PROMISE-Txformer则比基线UNETR分别达到7.6%、23.0%、2.1%和1.1%。 这些结果表明,各种建筑、成像模式和解剖目标不断改进,将PCCA和PROMISE-Net确立为一个可扩展、可概括的框架,以便在医学图像分解中迅速认识到分级特征。

articles.title: Unwarping the Lens: A Physics-Grounded Approach to Video Glasses Removal
articles.content: High-fidelity removal of eyeglasses from video is a major challenge in facial attribute editing, as the underlying facial geometry is often obscured by complex refractive distortions and view-dependent specular reflections. While large-scale generative priors have shown promise in eye-glasses removal via static image inpainting, they often lack the structural constraints necessary to maintain identity, expression, and pose, leading to visible "identity drift" in both static images and dynamic sequences. In this paper, we propose a novel transfer framework that addresses the stochastic nature of generative priors. Our pipeline first extracts high-fidelity synthetic face images from a commercial-grade generative model (Nano Banana, Gemini 3 Pro Image), regularizes them via a three-stage structural filtering process to preserve identity, expression, and pose, and finally applies physically-based simulation of lens optics during training to provide diverse, paired data. This process transfers Nano Banana's photo-realistic, multi-view knowledge into a specialized restoration architecture, JFSnet (Joint Feature-Spatial network). JFSnet integrates DINOv2-based semantic features with a convolutional decoder for spatial reconstruction, leveraging translation equivariance constraints to improve temporal consistency and high-frequency detail preservation. Evaluations on the curated Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) subset (12,163 images) show that our approach achieves high fidelity and structural accuracy, while maintaining inference speed of 27.68 FPS. In perceptual studies on CelebV-Text video sequences, our results are consistently preferred over diffusion and GAN-based baselines for ocular consistency, temporal stability, and overall restoration quality.

articles.title_zh: 解除对镜头的战备:对视频镜片的物理反射
articles.content_zh: 从视频中高纯度地去掉眼镜是面部属性编辑中的一大挑战,因为基础面部几何往往被复杂的折射性扭曲和视线依赖的光谱反射所掩盖. 虽然大规模基因前科通过静态图像涂抹在眼镜清除中表现出希望,但它们往往缺乏维持身份,表达和姿势所必需的结构约束,导致在静态图像和动态序列中都出现明显的"身份漂移". 在本文中,我们提出了一个新的转移框架,处理基因前科的扭曲性。 我们的输油管首先从商业级基因模型(Nano Banana,双子座3 Pro Image)中提取出高纯度合成面部图像,通过三阶段结构过滤过程对其进行规范化,以保存身份,表达,并摆姿势,最后在训练期间对镜头光学进行物理模拟,以提供多样的对等数据. 这个过程将纳诺·巴纳纳的摄影现实主义,多视图知识转移到一个专业的修复架构JFSnet(联合地物-空间网). JFSnet集成了DINov2-基于语义的特征,为空间重建配备了演化解码器,利用翻译等效约束,提高时间一致性和高频细节保存. 对Flickr-Faces-HQ(FFHQ)子集(12 163张图像)的评价显示,我们的方法实现了高度的忠诚和结构精度,同时保持了27.68 FPS的推论速度. 在关于CelebV-Text视频序列的感知研究中,我们的结果一直比传播和基于GAN的基线更受青睐,以保持视线一致性、时间稳定性和总体恢复质量。

articles.title: RoMAN-Flow: Taming Autoregressive Normalizing Flows for Offline Reinforcement Learning in Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: Offline reinforcement learning improves robotic policies using previously collected data without further environment interaction. Yet prevalent diffusion- and flow-matching robot policies lack tractable likelihoods, limiting their use in likelihood-based offline RL post-training. AR-NFs offer both expressive action modeling and exact likelihood evaluation, but their sequential sampling incurs substantial sampling overhead during policy optimization and deployment. We present RoMAN-Flow (Robotic Manipulation with Autoregressive Normalizing Flows), an offline reinforcement learning framework that makes AR-NF policies practical for robotic manipulation by addressing this sampling bottleneck in both stages. During policy optimization, RoMAN-Flow employs a sampling-free, advantage-weighted likelihood objective that assigns higher likelihood to high-advantage actions from the offline dataset without sampling from the autoregressive policy. For efficient deployment, it distills the optimized autoregressive policy into a one-step action generator, enabling low-latency action prediction. Experiments across multiple simulated manipulation benchmarks and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that RoMAN-Flow achieves competitive policy performance while substantially reducing inference latency. Code is available at https://github.com/konnyaku28/RoMAN-Flow.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RoMAN-Flow:机器人操纵中用于离线强化学习的调制自动递归常态流
articles.content_zh: 离线强化学习改进了利用先前收集的数据而无需进一步的环境互动的机器人政策。 然而,普遍的传播和流动匹配机器人政策缺乏可操作的可能性,限制了其使用,可能是基于离线的RL培训。 AR-NF既提供表现性行动模型,也提供准确的可能性评价,但其连续抽样在政策优化和部署过程中会产生大量的抽样间接费用。 我们介绍RoMAN-Flow(Robotic Manipulation with Autroressive Normalization Flows),这是一个离线强化学习框架,通过在两个阶段解决这一取样瓶颈,使AR-NF政策适用于机器人操纵。 在政策优化期间,RoMAN-Flow采用了无取样、优势加权的可能性目标,将较高的可能性分配给离线数据集的高优势行动,而不从自动递归政策中取样。 为了高效部署,它将优化的自动递减政策提炼成一个单步动作发生器,从而能够进行低纬度动作预测. 跨越多个模拟操纵基准和现实世界机器人平台的实验表明,RoMAN-Flow在大幅降低推论延迟性的同时,实现了具有竞争力的政策性能. 代码见https://github.com/konnyaku28/RoMAN-Flow。

articles.title: G3Ego: Gaze-Guided Graphs for Egocentric Action Understanding
articles.content:
Egocentric action understanding is often addressed using large video models pretrained on extensive exocentric datasets. However, many first-person actions depend on a small number of hand-object interactions involving only a few relevant entities.
  We propose G3Ego, a graph-based framework for egocentric action understanding that uses gaze as a structural cue to identify action-relevant entities in the scene. From sparsely sampled frames, G3Ego constructs action scene graphs from vision-language descriptions, grounded objects, and hand cues, and then prunes irrelevant entities using the camera wearer's gaze.
  The resulting graph embeddings are temporally aggregated for action recognition and anticipation. Unlike prior work that uses gaze primarily as an auxiliary modality or attention signal, G3Ego incorporates gaze directly into graph construction, producing efficient and interpretable representations focused on action-relevant interactions.
  Experiments on EGTEA Gaze+ and MECCANO show that G3Ego achieves competitive performance compared with video-based approaches and consistently improves Macro-F1 under class-imbalanced evaluation, while avoiding reliance on computationally expensive video pretraining. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gaze-guided graph representations for egocentric action understanding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: G3Ego:用于理解以Egocentral行动为目的的Gaze指导图
articles.content_zh:
egocentral 动作理解常使用大型视频模型进行处理,这些模型预先在广泛的异心数据集上训练. 然而,许多第一人称动作依赖于少数只涉及少数相关实体的手物交互.
我们提议G3Ego, 一个以图表为基础的框架, 以自我为中心的行动理解, G3Ego从很少采样的帧中,从视觉语言描述中构建动作场景图,被隔离的物体,以及手提示,然后利用摄像头穿戴者的目光来推敲无关的实体.
由此产生的图表嵌入部分按时间汇总,以便确认行动和预测。 与以前主要使用凝视作为辅助模式或关注信号的工作不同,G3Ego将凝视直接纳入图表构建,产生高效和可解释的表达,侧重于与行动相关的相互作用.
关于EGTEA Gaze+和MECCANO的实验显示,G3Ego与基于视频的方法相比,实现了竞争性的性能,在类平衡评价下持续改进Macro-F1,同时避免依赖计算昂贵的视频预训. 这些结果表明,以目视为指南的图表表述对自我中心行动的理解是有效的。

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence for Workflow Analysis in Colorectal Surgery: A Multicentric, Cross-Procedural Development and Generalization Study
articles.content: Minimally invasive colorectal surgeries (MIS-CRS) are characterised by significant variability and inconsistent outcomes. ColoWorkflow, a tool for the video-based assessment (VBA) of MIS-CRS workflow, was recently validated. However, manual VBA is time-consuming, limiting implementation. This study presents AI-ColoWorkflow, a deep learning model for automated surgical workflow analysis across MIS-CRS. Operative videos of MIS-CRS were collected from 4 centres and a publicly available dataset. Phases and steps were manually annotated according to ColoWorkflow. A deep learning model combining a fine-tuned DINOv3 vision transformer for per-frame visual feature extraction with a hierarchical multi-stage temporal convolutional network was jointly optimized for phase and step recognition. The model trained on pooled multicentric data, namely AI-ColoWorkflow was compared against centre-specific and procedure-specific models on a held-out test set. The following metrics were used for evaluation: macro F1 score, balanced accuracy, precision, and recall. AI-ColoWorkflow achieved a macro F1 of 73.01% $\pm$ 10.27 (balanced accuracy 73.43%) for phase recognition and 39.82% $\pm$ 7.06 (balanced accuracy 38.65%) for step recognition. The global model outperformed centre- and procedure-specific models in most experiments except procedure-specific step recognition. In the generalization analysis, mean F1 was 48.42% for phase recognition. AI-ColoWorkflow can reliably recognize MIS-CRS phases. A single model trained on pooled, multicentric, multi-procedural data generalises at least as well as and often better than centre- or procedure-specific models for phase recognition in MIS-CRS, while procedure-specific step models retain advantages for certain procedure types, motivating hybrid training strategies for future surgical AI development.

articles.title_zh: 色谱外科工作流程分析人工智能:多中心、跨程序发展和通用研究
articles.content_zh: 侵入性最小的结肠外科手术(MIS-CRS)的特点是变化很大,结果不一致。 ColoWorkflow是MIS-CRS工作流程的视频评估工具,最近得到验证。 然而,手动VBA是耗时的,限制了执行. 本研究介绍了AI-ColoWorkflow,这是跨MIS-CRS的自动化外科手术工作流程分析的深度学习模型. 从4个中心和一个可公开查阅的数据集收集了管理信息系统-中央遥感系统的运作视频。 阶段和步骤都是根据ColoWorkflow手动注释的. 结合精细化的DINOv3视觉变压器用于每帧视觉特征提取和分级多阶段时间演化网络的深层学习模式,被联合优化为相位和步位识别. 对集成多中心数据(即AI-ColoWorkflow)培训的模型,在一套搁置测试中与针对中心和程序的模型进行了比较。 下列衡量标准用于评价:宏观F1分数、均衡准确、精确和召回。 AI-ColoWorkflow实现了相位识别的宏F1为73.01%\pm$10.27(平衡精度73.43%),相位识别的宏F1为39.82%\pm$7.06(平衡精度38.65%). 在大多数实验中,全球模型的效绩都超过了中心与程序特定模型,但程序特定步骤识别除外. 在归纳分析中,相位识别的平均值F1为48.42%. AI-ColoWorkflow可以可靠地识别MIS-CRS阶段. 在MIS-CRS中,至少对集合、多中心、多程序数据一般化的单一模式进行了培训,而且往往优于中心或程序特定模式的阶段识别模式,而程序特定步骤模式则保留某些程序类型的优势,为今后的外科人工智能开发激励混合培训战略。

articles.title: PelviNeXt: A Modality-Agnostic Hybrid Network for Pelvic Imaging in Women's Health
articles.content: Women's health remains substantially under-resourced in medical imaging research, with pelvic pathologies such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and pelvic fracture both suffering from a scarcity of public, well-annotated benchmark data despite their clinical importance. We introduce PelviNeXt, a modality-agnostic hybrid architecture combining a dense convolutional feature extractor, hierarchical channel-spatial attention (H-CBAM), a multi-scale fusion module (MSFM), and talking-heads multi-head self-attention (TH-MHSA), applied without modification to both pelvic ultrasound and X-ray inputs. While benchmarking PelviNeXt on PCOSGen, the only gynaecologist-annotated public PCOS ultrasound dataset, we identified extensive exact and near-duplicate contamination within and across the dataset. We audit this contamination via perceptual hashing, publicly release a deduplicated version of the dataset, and establish the first integrity-audited evaluation protocol and baseline for PCOSGen under 5-fold cross-validation. On the only publicly available pelvic fracture X-ray dataset (PXR150), PelviNeXt exceeds previously reported state-of-the-art results across accuracy, recall, specificity, and AUROC. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component contributes to performance on both tasks. Our results demonstrate that a single architecture, applied without task-specific modification, can serve as a reliable foundation for pelvic imaging across modalities in data-scarce, under-researched areas of women's health.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PelviNEXt:妇女保健中佩尔维奇成像模式-不可知性混合网络
articles.content_zh: 妇女的健康在医学成像研究方面仍然资源严重不足,盆腔病变,如多细胞卵巢综合征(PCOS)和盆腔骨折,尽管它们具有临床重要性,但都缺乏公开的、说明充分的基准数据。 我们引入了PelviNEXt,一种模式-不可知性混合结构,结合了密集的演化特征提取器,分级通道-空间注意(H-CBAM),多尺度聚变模块(MSFM),以及谈话头多头自觉(TH-MHSA),不加修改地应用于盆腔超声和X射线输入. 虽然将PelviNEXt作为标注在PCOSGen上,这是唯一的妇科医生附加说明的PCOS超声波数据集,但我们发现该数据集内部和相互之间存在大量精确和几乎重复的污染。 我们通过感知散列来审计这种污染,公开发布数据集的破译版本,并为PCOSGen在5倍的交叉验证下确定第一个完整性审计评价协议和基线。 在唯一公开提供的骨盆断裂X射线数据集(PXR150)上,PelviNeXt在准确性、召回性、特异性和AUROC方面超过了以前报告的最新结果。 校对研究证实,每个建筑部分都有助于完成这两项任务。 我们的结果显示,在没有具体任务修改的情况下应用的单一结构可以作为数据匮乏、妇女保健研究不足领域不同模式的骨盆成像的可靠基础。

articles.title: DPC-Net: Dual-Prior Collaborative Network for All-in-One Image Restoration
articles.content: All-in-One Image Restoration (AiOIR) aims to handle diverse degradations within a unified model. However, existing methods often overlook image semantics in degradation modeling and lack low-level visual priors during reconstruction, leading to structural distortions and semantic inconsistencies. To address these issues, we propose a novel Dual-Prior Collaborative Network (DPC-Net), which achieves high-quality restoration by jointly exploiting degradation-semantic coupled priors and low-level visual priors. Specifically, degraded images are fed into a Degradation-Aware Network (DAN) to extract degradation-semantic coupled features. To this end, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) supervises DAN by constraining its features distribution, introducing image semantics into the encoding of degradation patterns. A Degradation-Semantic Modulation Module (DSMM) further translates this guidance into degradation-semantic coupling and propagates coupled representations to the decoder. During decoding, knowledge bases provide low-level visual priors, and the Dual-Prior Collaborative Reconstruction Module (DPCR) integrates dual-prior information to guide degradation removal while preserving structure and semantics, producing high-fidelity restored images. Extensive experiments on multiple restoration benchmarks demonstrate that DPC-Net achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art AiOIR methods.

articles.title_zh: DPC-Net:全方位图像修复双优先合作网络
articles.content_zh: 全合一图像恢复(AiOIR)的目标是在一个统一的模型中处理多种降解. 然而,现有方法在退化模型中常常忽略图像语义,在重建过程中缺乏低水平的视觉前兆,导致结构扭曲和语义不一致. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个新的双优先合作网络(DPC-Net),通过共同利用退化 -- -- 语义学前科和低水平视觉前科,实现高质量的恢复。 具体地说,退化的图像被输入一个退化-意识网络,以提取退化-语义结合特征。 为此,一个视觉语言模型(VLM)通过限制其特征分布,将图像语义引入退化模式的编码,来监督DAN. 降解 -- -- 语义模块(DSMM)进一步将这一指导转化为降解 -- -- 语义结合,并向解码器传播结合表述。 在解码过程中,知识库提供低级视觉前科,双优先合作重建模块(DPCR)整合双优先信息,指导降解除去,同时保留结构和语义,生成高纯度恢复图像. 对多种恢复基准的广泛试验表明,DPC-Net比照最先进的AiOIR方法取得了优异的性能.

articles.title: Feature Evolution and Migration during Vision Transformer Training
articles.content: We present a novel view on feature evolution in Vision Transformers (ViTs) by visualizing the training process over two dimensions -- network depth (layer) and training time (epochs). We employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to extract candidate sparse features from CLS-token representations and compare their activation profiles across epoch--layer pairs. This allows us to study feature-level dynamics that are not directly visible from representation-level similarity measures. Furthermore, we demonstrate how this framework of feature evolution allows us to describe feature migration, the change in the layer where a feature is most detectable during training. Our experiments show that migration is concentrated early in training, occurs more often toward earlier layers than toward deeper layers, and declines as feature organization stabilizes. We further find that deeper layers stabilize earlier and more strongly than shallow layers. The results show that our approach can be employed as a tool for understanding how ViTs learn and evolve.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉变形器期间的特性演变和迁移 培训
articles.content_zh: 我们对视觉变形器(ViTs)的特点演变提出了新颖的看法,将培训过程从两个方面 -- -- 网络深度(层)和培训时间(时代) -- -- 直观化。 我们使用Sparse自动编码器(SAEs)从 CLS-token 的表示中提取候选的稀疏特性,并比较它们跨时代层对的激活剖面. 这使得我们可以研究从代表级相似度测量中不能直接看到的特点级动态. 此外,我们演示了这种特征演化框架如何使我们能够描述特征迁移,即某一特征在培训期间最可探测的层的变化。 我们的实验表明,移民早期集中在培训上,更经常地朝更早的层次,而不是向更深的层次,随着特色组织的稳定而下降。 我们还发现,更深层比浅层更早和更稳定。 结果表明,我们的方法可以用作了解虚拟技术如何学习和演变的工具。

articles.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration with the Common-Sense Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs for Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Autonomous vehicles require robust perception and decision-making capabilities to operate in diverse and unseen scenarios. While reinforcement learning and rule-based methods can provide effective control and safety mechanisms, their performance may degrade in situations requiring contextual reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding multimodal information and generating contextual reasoning, however, their use for direct vehicle control can introduce latency and hallucination risks. To address these limitations, a hybrid framework is proposed. This system uses an orchestrator to coordinate PPO-trained reinforcement learning and PID control, with LLM common-sense reasoning applied throughout the framework. LLM reasoning is further employed iteratively to refine the RL reward function for dynamic driving environments. The proposed framework is evaluated in highly randomized CARLA scenarios under diverse environmental and traffic conditions. The results demonstrate the potential of integrating LLM-based reasoning with conventional autonomous driving methods while retaining structured control and safety mechanism.

articles.title_zh: 多代理管弦乐团与自主驾驶LLMS的常识理性能力
articles.content_zh: 自主的车辆需要有强有力的感知和决策能力,以便在各种不为人知的情况下运作。 虽然加强学习和基于规则的方法可以提供有效的控制和安全机制,但在需要背景推理的情况下,其性能可能会下降。 大语言模型(LLMS)在理解多式联运信息并产生背景推理方面表现出了强大的能力,但是,将其用于直接的车辆控制可带来延迟和幻觉风险。 为了克服这些局限性,建议建立一个混合框架。 这个系统使用一个管弦乐器来协调PPO训练的强化学习和PID控制,全框架应用LLM常识推理. LLM推理被进一步反复使用,以完善动态驱动环境的RL奖励功能. 在各种环境和交通条件下,对拟议框架进行了高度随机化的CARLA情景评价。 结果表明,在保留结构化控制和安全机制的同时,有可能将基于LLM的推理与传统的自主驾驶方法相结合。

articles.title: ID-VTG: Image-Disambiguated Video Temporal Grounding
articles.content: Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) faces significant challenges when natural language queries must distinguish between multiple events involving visually similar entities, particularly when relying on fine-grained visual attributes that are difficult to describe accurately in words alone. To address this, we introduce Image-Disambiguated Video Temporal Grounding (ID-VTG), a task that leverages multimodal queries combining a reference image and a text description to precisely localize segments where a specific instance performs a described action. To facilitate research, we construct two benchmarks: IDVTG-Gym, focusing on fine-grained, compositionally ordered gymnastics actions with athletes in similar uniforms; and IDVTG-InternVid, an open-world dataset featuring diverse entities (e.g., humans, animals, fictional characters) and significant temporal distractors. Methodologically, we propose the Visually-Guided Disambiguation Aggregation (VGD-Agg) framework based on a dual-branch fast-slow architecture. The fast branch efficiently generates preliminary event proposals, while the slow branch performs fine-grained frame-level matching between video frames and the reference image. We enhance discriminability via two learnable tokens: a Compare Token, which represents hard negatives to probe for the presence of the target instance (as referred to by the query image), and a Depress Value, which represents text-irrelevant events. Proposals that the Compare Token identifies as lacking the target instance are pushed toward the Depress Value, thus easing disambiguation via the text query. Extensive experiments validate our approach, which achieves state-of-the-art results on the proposed benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/ID-VTG.

articles.title_zh: ID-VTG:图像分离 视频时间定位
articles.content_zh: 视频Temperal Grounding(VTG)面临重大挑战,自然语言查询必须区分涉及视觉上相似实体的多个事件,特别是依赖于精细的视觉属性,这些属性单词难以准确描述. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了图像分散视频临时定位(ID-VTG),这是一项利用多种模式查询的任务,将参考图像和文本描述结合起来,将特定实例进行描述动作的部分精确定位。 为了便利研究,我们构建了两个基准:IDVTG-Gym,专注于精细的,有构思地命令与身着类似制服的运动员进行体操动作;IDVTG-InternVid,一个由不同实体(如人类,动物,虚构人物)和显著的时间分心器组成的开放世界数据集. 从方法上讲,我们提出基于双分支快慢结构的可视化指导分化聚合(VGD-Agg)框架. 快速分支高效生成初步事件建议,而慢分支在视频帧和参考图像之间进行精细的帧级匹配. 我们通过两个可学习的符号增强歧视性:一个是比较Token,它代表了探测目标实例的硬底片(如查询图像所提到的),另一个是Depress value,它代表了文本无关的事件. 比较Token认为缺少目标实例的建议被推向减压值,从而通过文本查询缓解了混淆。 广泛的实验验证了我们的方法,这种方法在拟议基准上取得了最新的结果。 代码见https://github.com/oceanflowlab/ID-VTG。

articles.title: ArmorOCR: Grounded Adversarial Visual Perception via Observation-Transferred Self-Distillation
articles.content: Large multimodal models (LMMs) have demonstrated strong OCR recognition capabilities, yet remain vulnerable to adversarial visual text that is readable to humans but challenging for models to localize and recognize. Existing OCR benchmarks mainly focus on natural or document-style text, while adversarial OCR evaluations remain limited in scale, task coverage, or region-aware evaluation. In this paper, we formulate adversarial OCR as a \textbf{grounded OCR perception} task and introduce \textbf{AdvSpot}, the first benchmark for grounded adversarial OCR evaluation. AdvSpot comprises 390 images with region-level annotations, spanning 5 primary categories and 13 fine-grained adversarial OCR types. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{ArmorOCR}, a two-stage training framework for robust adversarial OCR perception. ArmorOCR first acquires missing adversarial OCR perception from privileged transformed observations through On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), and then refines grounded OCR perception through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-conditioned rewards for localization, recognition, full spotting, and visual question answering (VQA). Experiments on our AdvSpot, other adversarial OCR benchmarks, and general OCR benchmarks demonstrate that ArmorOCR consistently improves adversarial OCR perception while preserving competitive general OCR capability.

articles.title_zh: 装甲OCR:通过观测-转移的地面反向视觉感受 自我分裂
articles.content_zh: 大型多式联运模型(LMMs)已显示出强大的OCR识别能力,但仍易受人类可以读取的对抗视觉文本的影响,但对模型进行本地化和识别具有挑战性. 现有的OCR基准主要侧重于自然文本或文件式文本,而对抗性的OCR评价在规模、任务覆盖面或区域认知评价方面仍然有限。 在本文中,我们提出对抗性OCR作为\textbf{基于OCR感知}的任务,并引入\textbf{AdvSpot},这是基于对抗性OCR评价的第一个基准. AdvSpot包含390幅带有区域说明的图像,分为5个主要类别和13种精细的对抗性OCR类型. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议\textbf{ArmorOCR},一个两阶段的训练框架,用于强烈的对抗性OCR观念. ArmorOCR首先通过On-Political Self-disprection(OPSD)从特权转变的观察中获取缺失的对抗性OCR感知,然后通过Group相对政策优化(GRPO)完善基于OCR感知,对本地化,识别,全发现和视觉问答(VQA)进行任务附加条件的奖励. 关于我们的AdvSpot、其他对抗性OCR基准和一般OCR基准的实验表明,ArmorOCR在保持竞争性的一般OCR能力的同时,不断改善对抗性OCR的观念。

articles.title: Flow Matching-Based PET Image Reconstruction
articles.content: Generative models have shown strong potential for positron emission tomography (PET) image reconstruction. Although diffusion model-based reconstruction methods have demonstrated promising performance, they often require many reverse sampling steps with data-consistency updates incorporated into the sampling process. Flow matching offers an attractive alternative because it can directly estimate clean images from intermediate states, allowing data-consistency refinement to be separated from flow propagation. In this work, we proposed flow matching-based PET image reconstruction methods. We first established PET-FlowDPS by incorporating Poisson likelihood guidance with an expectation-maximization (EM)-based preconditioner into the FlowDPS framework. We then proposed a model-based PET reconstruction method that used a pretrained flow matching model as a prior, in which the flow-based prior, PET data refinement, and stochastic propagation were interpreted within an approximate Bayesian framework. Experimental results using [$^{\text{18}}\text{F}$]FDG brain PET datasets showed that the proposed method achieved better bias-variance trade-offs across different dose levels compared with other reference methods. These results demonstrated the potential of flow matching as a generative prior for quantitative PET image reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: 基于流量匹配的 PET 图像重建
articles.content_zh: 基因模型表明,正态排放成像法(PET)图像重建具有很大的潜力。 虽然基于传播模型的重建方法显示出有希望的表现,但它们往往需要许多反向取样步骤,并将数据一致性更新纳入取样过程。 流量匹配提供了一个有吸引力的替代方案,因为它可以直接估计中间状态的清洁图像,使数据一致性的完善与流量传播分离. 在这项工作中,我们提出了基于流量匹配的PET图像重建方法. 我们首先建立了PET-FlowDPS,将基于预期-最大化(EM)的Poisson可能性指导纳入FFlowDPS框架。 然后,我们提出了一个基于模型的PET重建方法,将预先训练的流量匹配模型作为前置模型,其中基于流量的PET数据精细化和结构化的传播在一个大致的巴伊西亚框架内进行解释。 实验结果使用 [$^{\text{18}}\text{F}$] FDG脑PET数据集显示,与其他参考方法相比,拟议方法在不同剂量水平上实现了更好的偏差-变异权衡. 这些结果表明,在定量PET图像重建之前,流动匹配有可能成为基因组合。

articles.title: BeyondMasks: Evaluating Causal and Physical Consistency in Video Object Removal
articles.content: Recent advances in generative video models have significantly improved visual realism in video object removal, yet evaluation protocols still focus on masked region fidelity, treating removal as local inpainting. In real scenes, object removal is a causal intervention: eliminating an object also requires removing its induced physical effects, such as shadows, reflections, illumination changes, translucency, and dynamic traces. Existing benchmarks lack aligned clean references or remain limited to simplified synthetic settings, preventing systematic evaluation of causal consistency. We introduce BeyondMasks, a paired benchmark for causally consistent video object removal, consisting of temporally aligned synthetic and real world video pairs with clean background references. The dataset spans diverse photometric, geometric, volumetric, and dynamic interactions, and supports both mask based and instruction driven editing. We further propose CORE, a structured vision language model based evaluation protocol that jointly measures object disappearance and after effect consistency, aligning more closely with human judgments than existing metrics. Benchmarking state of the art methods reveals systematic failures in removing secondary physical effects despite high masked region fidelity, exposing a gap between visual plausibility and causal correctness. BeyondMasks reframes video object removal as causal scene consistency rather than local reconstruction and provides a unified framework for its evaluation.

articles.title_zh: BeyondMasks:评估视频对象清除过程中的因果关系和物理一致性
articles.content_zh: 基因视频模型最近的进步大大改善了视频物体清除中的视觉现实主义,然而评价协议仍然侧重于蒙蔽的区域忠诚,将清除视为局部的涂料. 在真实的场景中,清除物体是一种因果干预:消除一个物体还需要去除其诱导的物理效应,如阴影,反射,光照变化,透明,和动态的痕迹. 现有基准缺乏一致的干净参考,或仅限于简化合成环境,从而无法对因果关系进行系统评估。 我们引入了BeyondMasks,是因果一致的视频对象清除的对准基准,由时间对齐的合成和真实的世界视频配对组成,具有干净的背景参考. 数据集跨越不同的光度、几何、体积和动态相互作用,支持基于面具和指令驱动的编辑。 我们进一步提出CORE, 一种结构化的愿景语言模型基于评价协议, 联合衡量消失和效果之后的一致性, 与现有的衡量标准相比更紧密地与人类判断保持一致. 以技术水平为基准的方法显示,尽管区域忠诚度很高,但在消除次级物理影响方面却出现了系统性的失败,暴露了视觉可信性与因果正确性之间的差距。 超越 Masks将视频对象移除重新设定为因果场景一致性而非局部重建,并为评估提供了统一的框架.

articles.title: Structured Affinity for Unsupervised Visual Class-Incremental Memory in Deep Artificial Immune Networks
articles.content: Artificial immune networks (AINs) are naturally memory-forming systems, but conventional visual AINs often rely on flattened vector affinity that ignores spatial structure. This paper studies whether structured, gradient-free immune affinity can make Deep AINs viable as replay-free visual class-incremental representation-memory learners. Visual B-cells are formalized as structured templates, including shifted-template affinity, zero-normalized cross-correlation (ZNCC) filters, and feature-map binding profiles. A repertoire is treated both as memory and as a representation-inducing basis, while depth is obtained by passing binding-profile response maps to subsequent immune layers. The resulting Deep AIN exhibits adaptive latent coordinate reorganization: as new classes arrive, the binding-profile space evolves while retaining recoverable structure for earlier classes. Experiments on sklearn digits, MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and KMNIST show that preserving response maps is critical. Scalar binding-profile variants underperform, whereas feature-map Deep AINs learn class-discriminative visual memory without replay, label-driven immune updates, or backpropagation through the immune layers. On sklearn digits, downstream probes fitted on the learned binding profiles reach 0.939 final balanced accuracy with logistic regression and 0.902 with 1-nearest-neighbour after all ten classes are encountered, with initial-class retention of 0.978. Adaptive layer-wise scale calibration further improves the two-layer feature-map Deep AIN to 0.978 balanced accuracy. With the same calibration rule, Fashion-MNIST reaches 0.814 and KMNIST reaches 0.853. These probes are external validation tools, not components of the AIN. The results identify structured affinity, response-map preservation, adaptive latent reorganization, and layer-wise scale calibration as key mechanisms for replay-free visual immune memory.

articles.title_zh: 深人造免疫网络中无监督视觉类-增量记忆的结构化无限
articles.content_zh: 人工免疫网络(AINs)是天然的内存成型系统,但常规的视觉AIN经常依赖于忽略空间结构的扁平向量亲和性. 本文研究了结构化的,无梯度的免疫亲和性是否能够使Deep AINs成为无重播的视觉类-增量表现-记忆学习者. 视觉B细胞被正式化为结构化的模板,包括转动-template亲和,零常态的交叉对映(ZNCC)滤镜,以及特征图绑定配置. 复刻版既被视为记忆,也被视为一种表现诱导基础,而深度则通过向后续免疫层传递绑定式反应图而获得. 由此产生的 " 深度 " 显示具有适应性的潜在坐标重组:随着新类的到来,约束性空间不断演变,同时为早期类保留可收回的结构。 关于闪烁数字的实验, MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, 和 KMINIST 的实验显示,保存反应图至关重要. scalar绑定的变体表现不佳,而特征图深AINs则学习阶级区别的视觉记忆,而不进行重播,标签驱动的免疫更新,或者通过免疫层进行反传播. 在闪烁数字上,安装在已学习到的装订图谱上的下游探测器达到0.939最终平衡准确度,后勤回归,在遇到所有十类之后,0.902在近邻一级,初始级保留量为0.978。 适应性地层级校准进一步提高了双层特征图深AIN的0.978平衡精度. 以相同的校准规则,时装-MNIST达到0.814,KMINIST达到0.853. 这些探测器是外部验证工具,而不是AIN的组件. 结果确定了结构化的亲和性、反应图的保存、适应性潜在重组和分层尺度校准,作为无反弹视觉免疫记忆的关键机制。

articles.title: HandMvNet: Real-Time 3D Hand Pose Estimation Using Multi-View Cross-Attention Fusion
articles.content: In this work, we present HandMvNet, one of the first real-time method designed to estimate 3D hand motion and shape from multi-view camera images. Unlike previous monocular approaches, which suffer from scale-depth ambiguities, our method ensures consistent and accurate absolute hand poses and shapes. This is achieved through a multi-view attention-fusion mechanism that effectively integrates features from multiple viewpoints. In contrast to previous multi-view methods, our approach eliminates the need for camera parameters as input to learn 3D geometry. HandMvNet also achieves a substantial reduction in inference time while delivering competitive results compared to the state-of-the-art methods, making it suitable for real-time applications. Evaluated on publicly available datasets, HandMvNet qualitatively and quantitatively outperforms previous methods under identical settings. Code is available at github.com/pyxploiter/handmvnet.

articles.title_zh: HandMvNet: 实时3D手拍估计使用多维交叉连接
articles.content_zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了HandMvNet,这是第一个实时方法之一,旨在从多视相机图像中估计3D手动和形状. 与以往的单体方法不同,我们的方法确保了一致和准确的绝对手形和形状。 这是通过一个从多个角度有效整合特征的多视角关注-融合机制来实现的. 与之前的多视图方法不同,我们的方法消除了作为输入来学习3D几何学的相机参数的需要. 与最先进的方法相比,HandMvNet在提供竞争结果的同时也实现了大量缩短推论时间,使其适合实时应用. 对公开的数据集进行了评价,HandMvNet在质量和数量上都超过了以前在相同设置下采用的方法。 代码见github.com/pyxploiter/handmvnet.

articles.title: V-REX: Efficient Specialist VLM Training for Veterinary X-Rays
articles.content: While generalist VLMs are expensive to train, creating domain experts is widely assumed to require fine-tuning increasingly large foundation models. We show that, in veterinary radiology, this assumption is misguided. By rethinking the entire VLM pipeline - from text tokenisation and pre-training to grounding and inference - we demonstrate that careful engineering can yield models that outperform much larger foundation models from scratch, without relying on any other data. Our approach introduces new strategies for generative pre-training and grounding that improve training efficiency, increasing data utilisation and downstream performance. Using only a fraction of the parameters, data, and compute of contemporary generalist models, we develop the first VLM capable of generating diagnostic reports for veterinary radiographs, surpassing open foundation models on this task by significant margin.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: V-REX:高效专家VLM 兽医X射线培训
articles.content_zh: 通论者 VLM培训费用昂贵,创建域专家被广泛认为需要精细调整越来越大的基础模型. 我们显示,在兽医放射学中,这种假设是错误的。 通过重新思考整个VLM管道——从文字标记和预先训练到地面和推论——我们表明,仔细的工程可以产生从头到尾都比大得多的基础模型更好的模型,而不依赖任何其他数据。 我们的方法引入了提高培训效率、增加数据利用和下游业绩的基因预培训和基础建设的新战略。 仅使用一小部分参数,数据和当代通论模型的计算,我们开发了第一个能够为兽医放射图生成诊断报告的VLM,大大超过了这一任务的开放基础模型.

articles.title: Gravity-aware partially calibrated absolute pose estimation from affine- or rotation-covariant features
articles.content: Inertial measurement units (IMUs) are now standard in most consumer devices, such as smartphones, drones, and extended reality (XR) headsets. By fusing visual and inertial data, localization systems gain significantly in speed and robustness compared to vision-only or IMU-only approaches. However, traditional pose estimation methods fail to utilize the local geometric information embedded in feature descriptors like SIFT. Recent work has proved the advantages of leveraging this information for relative and absolute pose estimation, but its application to partially calibrated absolute pose estimation remains unexplored. In this paper, we derive novel constraints for joint estimation of absolute pose and focal length, making use of a gravity vector obtained from IMU data and the feature-induced local geometry, which we use to construct two efficient solvers: UP1PfAC, that operates given a single affine correspondence and UP2PfORI, which requires two orientation-covariant features. Unlike traditional, semi-calibrated absolute pose methods requiring four point correspondences, our solvers benefit from fewer samples and lower computational cost, simplifying robust estimation in modern RANSAC-like frameworks. We evaluate the proposed solvers against the state-of-the-art on large-scale public datasets and demonstrate that our method achieves fast and accurate localization and focal length estimation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从亲缘或旋转相变特征部分校准的绝对姿势估计
articles.content_zh: 惰性测量单元(IMU)现在在大多数消费设备,如智能手机,无人机,以及扩展现实(XR)耳机中都是标准的. 通过将视觉和惯性数据引信,本地化系统在速度和稳健性方面比仅视或只视IMU的方法大增. 然而,传统的姿势估计方法未能利用SIFT等特征描述符中嵌入的局部几何信息. 最近的工作证明,利用这种信息进行相对和绝对的假设估计是有好处的,但其应用于部分校准的绝对假设估计仍然没有得到探讨。 在本文中,我们得出了对绝对姿势和焦距的联合估计的新限制,利用了从IMU数据中获得的重力矢量和特征引起的局部几何,我们用这些矢量构建了两个高效的解析器:UP1PfAC,它运行给一个单一的近亲通信,UP2PfORI,它需要两个方向-共性特征. 与传统,半校准的绝对姿势方法需要四点对应不同,我们的解题者受益于较少的样本和较低的计算成本,简化了现代RANSAC类框架中的稳健估计. 我们对照大规模公共数据集的最新技术,评估提议的解决方案,并表明我们的方法实现了快速和准确的本地化和焦距估计。

articles.title: An Inclusive and Lightweight Approach to Federated Continual Learning for Cultural Heritage
articles.content: Artificial intelligence can support cultural heritage and digital humanities through large-scale retrieval and analysis of digitized collections. However, cultural heritage data are often distributed across institutions, constrained by ownership and access restrictions, and continuously evolving over time. Federated Continual Learning (FCL) is well suited to this setting, as it enables models to learn from distributed and sequential data without sharing raw collections. In this paper, we propose FedCurv-DR, a lightweight, regularisation-based FCL strategy. The method accumulates parameter-importance estimates across clients and experiences to protect learned knowledge, while updating them only at fixed intervals to minimize communication and computation overhead. We evaluate FedCurv-DR in a continual learning scenario using the WikiArt image dataset for genre classification with evolving styles, reporting performance, energy, and fairness metrics. Our results show that FedCurv- DR reduces forgetting and balances performance, fairness, and energy efficiency for sustainable AI in cultural heritage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 联邦文化遗产持续学习的包容性和轻量级方法
articles.content_zh: 人工智能可以通过大规模检索和分析数字化藏品来支持文化遗产和数字人文. 然而,文化遗产数据往往在各机构之间分布,受到所有权和获取限制的限制,并随着时间的推移不断演变。 联邦持续学习(FCL)非常适合这一设置,因为它使模型能够从分布式和顺序式的数据中学习,而不分享原始的收集. 在本文中,我们提出了FedCurv-DR,一种轻量级,基于规范化的FCL策略. 该方法积累了不同客户和经验的参数重要性估计数,以保护学到的知识,同时只在固定的间隔时间更新这些估计数,以尽量减少沟通和计算间接费用。 FedCurv-DR在持续学习的情况下使用WikiArt图像数据集进行流派分类, 我们的结果显示 FedCurv - DR 减少了对文化遗产中可持续人工智能的遗忘和平衡性、公正性和能效。

articles.title: From Street View Imagery to Street Quality Indicators: Vision Language Inference for the Suburban 15-minute City
articles.content: Streetscape quality has become a central concern in contemporary urban planning, particularly within the framework of the pedestrian-friendly 15-minute city, where walkability and public-space quality are increasingly recognized as key determinants of urban performance. However, assessing streetscape qualities across large suburban and peri-urban territories remains challenging due to the time and resource demands of conventional field surveys. This paper presents a planning-oriented assessment of streetscape qualities in the north-eastern periphery of Nice (France) using the latest release of SAGAI (Streetscape Analysis with Generative AI), an open-source workflow that leverages vision-language models (VLMs) for large-scale streetscape analysis from Google Street View imagery. The new release addresses limitations of the original framework through improved image acquisition, geographically consistent view generation, support for multiple VLM architectures, consensus-based inference, and an integrated analytical environment. The workflow is applied to several thousand street-level observations to evaluate qualities relevant to pedestrian-friendly urban environments: sidewalk presence, pedestrian entrance density, and vegetation. The resulting maps reveal that the desired streetscape qualities characterize only a fraction of today's suburban streetscapes, mainly in compact developments and traditional suburban faubourgs, while they are particularly lacking on residential hills. The analysis demonstrates the potential of contemporary VLMs to support urban diagnostics in extensive suburban territories where fieldwork would be prohibitively time-consuming. Beyond the case study, the paper illustrates how recent advances in vision-language models can contribute to evidence-based planning by enabling scalable, flexible, and interpretable assessments of urban public-space quality.

articles.title_zh: 从街景图像到街景质量 指标:郊区15分钟城市的远景语言推论
articles.content_zh: 街道景观质量已成为当代城市规划的一个中心问题,特别是在方便行人15分钟的城市框架内,人们日益认识到步行能力和公共场所质量是城市绩效的关键决定因素。 然而,由于常规实地调查的时间和资源需要,对大郊区和近郊区的街道景观质量的评估仍然具有挑战性。 本文利用最新发布的SAGAI(Streetscape Analysis with Generative AI),对尼斯(法国)东北部外围的街道景观品质进行了以规划为导向的评估,这是一个开放源码工作流程,它利用了来自Google Street View图像的愿景语言模型(VLMs)进行大规模街道景观分析. 新版通过改进图像获取,地理上一致的视图生成,支持多个VLM架构,基于共识的推论,以及综合分析环境来解决原始框架的局限性. 工作流程适用于数千个街道层面的观测,以评估与方便行人的城市环境有关的素质:人行道存在、行人入口密度和植被。 由此绘制的地图显示,人们所期望的街道景观品质只是今天郊区街道景观的一小部分,主要表现在紧凑的发展和传统的郊区荒地,而居民丘陵则特别缺乏这些景观。 分析表明,在大片郊区,现代自愿人工智能有可能支持城市诊断,因为实地工作将耗费大量时间。 除案例研究外,该文件还说明了近期在愿景语言模式方面取得的进展如何通过对城市公共空间质量进行可扩展、灵活和可解释的评估,对循证规划作出贡献。

articles.title: Manifold Drift in Flow Preference Optimization: A Root Cause of Reward Hacking
articles.content: Preference optimization is a standard alignment method for generative models, yet extending it to continuous-time dynamics remains non-trivial. In flow matching, reward-driven updates modify transport trajectories without an inherent constraint to the pretrained data manifold and can move terminal samples off the pretrained support. We formalize this failure mode as manifold drift. Theoretically, we show that optimal flow matching recovers the terminal data distribution, whereas a preference update leaves the pretrained manifold whenever its induced terminal displacement has a nonzero normal component. As a remedy, we propose ThermoDPO, a temperature-controlled objective that anchors pairwise preference optimization on preferred samples. Across temperature regimes, this objective connects rejection sampling fine-tuning and FlowDPO and controls a pointwise reconstruction-based surrogate for manifold distance. To counteract diminished signals at low temperatures, we further introduce a weighted variant, ThermoDPO-weighted. On the main toy benchmark, ThermoDPO-weighted attains a StrictScore of 0.899, compared with 0.629 for FlowDPO and 0.857 for FlowDPO+RFT. On SD3.5-M at CFG = 4.5, it improves OCR by 47.5% and the average of four metrics by 16.0%.

articles.title_zh: 流动偏好优化中的机动漂流:奖励打包的根源
articles.content_zh: 首选优化是基因模型的标准配对方法,然而将其扩展到连续时间动力学仍为非三角. 在流量匹配中,奖励驱动的更新会修改运输轨迹,而不会对预训数据复数产生内在的限制,并可将终端样本从预训支持中移出. 我们把失败模式正式化为多重漂移。 理论上,我们表明,最佳流动匹配可恢复终端数据分布,而只要其引发的终端移位具有非零正常成分,首选更新就会留下预先训练的倍数。 作为一种补救措施,我们提出ThermoDPO,一个温度控制的目标,将双向偏好优化于首选样品上. 在整个温度制度中,这一目标将拒绝取样微调和FlowDPO联系起来,并控制一个以点位重建为基础的多重距离代用物。 为了抵消低温下信号的减弱,我们进一步采用了一个加权变体,ThermoDPO加权。 在主要玩具基准上,ThermoDPO加权得分为0.899,而FlowDPO为0.629,FlowDPO+RFT为0.857。 在CFG=4.5的SD3.5-M上,它使OCR提高了47.5%,平均四个度量衡提高了16.0%.

articles.title: Point-Based 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views under Known Illumination
articles.content:
Sparse view 3D reconstruction is commonly addressed with neural implicit surfaces or dense point-based representations such as Gaussian splatting. Surface-aware splatting methods improve extracted geometry through oriented primitives and regularization, while RadiosityGS incorporates differentiable light transport through a radiosity inspired finite-element surfel formulation. We propose a differentiable point rendering method based on opacity-bearing beta surfels. An opacity explicit adjoint light transport formulation provides gradients for surfel geometry and appearance parameters, allowing physically based light transport to constrain reconstruction.
  Across five synthetic objects reconstructed from ten posed views, our method achieves the lowest mean symmetric Chamfer distance among the evaluated baselines and reduces mean Chamfer distance by 28.5% relative to the strongest point-based baseline while using only 267 surfels on average, approximately ~161 fewer primitives. Directional Chamfer results further show improved accuracy and competitive completion relative to related point-based methods. These results show that, in the controlled direct illumination setting, compact beta surfels combined with transport-based optimization can recover surfaces without relying on the tens to hundreds of thousands of primitives used by the evaluated baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在已知光照下从 Sparse 视图进行点位的 3D 重建
articles.content_zh:
Sparse view 3D重建通常以神经内含的表面或密集的点位表示如高斯电镀处理. 地表意识电镀法通过定向原始和规范化改进了提取的几何学,而射电学GS则通过受射电启发的有限元素冲浪配方,融合了不同的光传输. 我们提出一个不同点的渲染方法 基于不透明 β表面。 一种不透明度的显式联合光传输配方为表面几何和外观参数提供了梯度,使物理上的光传输能够约束重建.
在从10个角度重建的五个合成物体中,我们的方法在评估的基线中实现了最小的平均对称查姆费尔距离,并将平均查姆费尔距离比最强的点基基线减少28.5%,同时平均只使用267个冲浪,大约减少161个原始人。 与相关点法相比,定向查姆费尔结果进一步表明准确性和竞争性完成性有所提高。 这些结果显示,在受控的直接照明设定中,紧凑的β冲浪与基于运输的优化相结合,可以恢复表面,而无需依赖被评估的基线所使用的数万至数十万原始物.

articles.title: STEP: Score-Based Temporal Energy for Human Pose Video Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Skeleton-based Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) offers a robust, privacy-preserving solution for identifying abnormal behaviors. To model the distribution of normal static and moving poses, recent methods train Energy-Based Models (EBMs) via Denoising Score Matching (DSM). However, directly injecting noise, required for training, into raw joint coordinates creates physically impossible poses, and this structural collapse severely worsens as the temporal window expands. To address this, we introduce STEP, a simple framework that utilizes Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to project pose sequences into a compact, whitened PC-space. Learning the data density within this well-behaved PC-space ensures that the injected noise translates into physically plausible variations, which allows the model to process longer video sequences without the performance collapse of raw coordinate baselines. Additionally, to mitigate inherent pose estimation inaccuracies arising from occlusions or motion blur, we integrate a sequence-level weighting mechanism based on the estimator's confidence scores. Operating at real-time computational efficiency, our simple and lightweight framework outperforms the previous skeleton-based state-of-the-art by 12.2% (90.1% AUROC) on the challenging UBnormal dataset and achieves highly competitive results by improving on the ShanghaiTech benchmark.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: STEP: 人类Pose视频异常检测的计分时间能量
articles.content_zh: 基于Skeleton的视频异常检测(VAD)为识别异常行为提供了一个强有力的隐私保护解决方案. 为了模拟正常静态和移动姿势的分布,最近的方法通过Denoising Score Matching(DSM)来训练基于能源的模型. 然而,培训所需的直接注入噪声会形成物理上不可能的姿势,这种结构崩溃随着时间窗口的扩大而严重恶化。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了STEP,这是一个简单的框架,利用主要组件分析(PCA)将排列顺序投射成一个紧凑的,白色的PC空间. 学习这个行为良好的PC-空间内的数据密度可以确保注入的噪声转化为物理上可行的变化,这使得模型可以处理较长的视频序列,而不会发生原始坐标基线的性能崩溃. 此外,为了减少因隔离或运动模糊而产生的内在估计不准确,我们综合了基于估计者信心分数的顺序级加权机制。 以实时计算效率运行,我们的简单轻量级框架在具有挑战性的UBNormal数据集上比以往基于骨架的先进水平(90.1%AUROC)高出12.2%,并通过改进上海科技基准,实现高度竞争性的结果.

articles.title: Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Detection with Co-Distillation Discovery and Dual Guidance Robust Training
articles.content: Recently, open-vocabulary 3D object detection (3D-OVD) has gained increasing attention for its ability to detect unseen objects in 3D scenes. Existing approaches typically adopt a two-stage pipeline that first discovers novel objects using foundation models and then trains a 3D-OVD model based on these discovered objects. Although effective, this pipeline often suffers from inaccurate localization and mismatched classification during the discovery stage, which subsequently limits the performance of the model training stage. To address these limitations, we advocate for improving both the reliability of novel object discovery and the robustness of model training, and propose an innovative framework. Specifically, for reliable discovery, our co-distillation strategy distills high-quality novel objects by applying Hungarian matching over a comprehensive score that incorporates geometric consistency, structural objectness, and semantic certainty. To enhance robust model training, we further propose a dual-guidance learning scheme, incorporating a scene-awareness-guided uncertainty regularization for the regression head and an LLM-guided hierarchical alignment for the classification head, effectively mitigating the negative effects of imprecise 3D bounding boxes and semantic ambiguity. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2 demonstrate that our method achieves significant performance gains over state-of-the-art approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/shangboyuan/Co-3DGT
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 开放式词汇 3D 对象检测,并采用共同分散发现和双向引导强性培训
articles.content_zh: 最近,开放的Vobulary 3D物体探测(3D-OVD)因其在3D场景中探测未见物体的能力而获得越来越多的关注. 现有方法一般采用两阶段的管道,首先利用地基模型发现新的物体,然后根据这些发现的物体来训练3D-OVD模型. 这一管道虽然有效,但在发现阶段往往存在不准确的本地化和不匹配的分类,这随后限制了模型培训阶段的性能. 为了克服这些局限性,我们主张提高新发现物体的可靠性和模式培训的稳健性,并提出一个创新的框架。 具体地说,为了可靠地发现,我们的共同沉淀策略通过将匈牙利语比对适用于包含几何一致性、结构对象和语义确定性的全面分数来提炼出高质量的新事物。 为了加强有力的模式培训,我们进一步提出了一个双重指导学习计划,纳入回归头的场景意识指导不确定性规范化和分类头的LLM指导等级调整,有效减轻3D界限框不准确和语义模糊的负面影响. SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2的广泛实验表明,我们的方法比最先进的方法取得了显著的性能收益. 代码见https://github.com/shangboyuan/Co-3DGT。

articles.title: PVRA: A Pointwise Key-point Voting Framework for Robotic Assembly
articles.content: Modern computer vision has enabled partial autonomy in robotic assembly manipulation. However, performing autonomous manipulation of a progressive assembly demands a more specific set of skills, in addition to perceiving the objects. Through a comparative analysis of research in the associated domains, we deduce that object-centric perception must advance towards learning assembly dependencies to predict meaningful actionable outputs for autonomous assembly manipulation. Subsequently, we present a 3D keypoint-based modular learning framework to learn assembly dependencies to infer actionable outputs given a RGB-D input of an assembly scene. We train and evaluate our trained network on an assembly pose estimation dataset and compare it against object-centric baselines with an augmented set of metrics for progressive assemblies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PVRA:机器人大会的尖端关键点投票框架
articles.content_zh: 现代计算机视觉在机器人组装操纵方面实现了部分自主. 然而,对进化组装进行自主操纵,除了能感知物体外,还需要一套更具体的技能. 通过对相关领域的研究进行比较分析,我们推断,以物体为中心的观念必须朝学习组装依赖性的方向发展,以预测可用于自主组装操纵的有意义的可操作产出。 随后,我们提出了一个基于3D关键点的模块化学习框架,以学习组装依赖性,根据组装场景的RGB-D输入推导可操作输出. 我们培训和评估我们训练有素的关于组装的网络,提出估计数据集,并与以物体为中心的基线比较,并增加一套渐进组装的计量标准。

articles.title: Flow Matching Meets 3D Curvilinear Structure Segmentation in Medical Imaging
articles.content: Segmentation of curvilinear anatomical structures in 3D medical images remains challenging due to complex topology, severe class imbalance, weak contrast, and large variations in structure morphology. While deep learning approaches for 3D curvilinear segmentation have been proposed, they are often tailored to specific anatomies or modalities, limiting generalization across clinical settings and leaving room for improvement. Recent generative models have shown the benefits of iterative prediction for structured segmentation tasks, yet diffusion-based methods suffer from computationally expensive sampling, hindering their use on high-resolution 3D volumes. We present 3D-CurvSegFlow, a flow matching-based model for 3D curvilinear structure segmentation. The model learns a continuous transformation from a simple source distribution to the target vascular representation, enabling progressive refinement of complex curvilinear geometries with efficient inference. We evaluate our method on Three public challenging datasets covering distinct anatomies and modalities: portal vein, cerebral vessel, and coronary arteries. Using a common architecture and training strategy across all tasks, our method outperforms general-purpose and vessel-specific approaches, with strong preservation of thin branches and vascular continuity. This work not only advances the state-of-the-art in 3D curvilinear segmentation but also opens new avenues for efficient, generalizable, and clinically applicable methods in medical image analysis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 流程匹配在医学成像中满足 3D 曲线结构分割
articles.content_zh: 3D医学影像中曲线解剖结构的分化仍然具有挑战性,原因是地形复杂,阶级失衡严重,对比度低,结构形态差异较大. 虽然有人提出了3D卷曲分解的深层学习方法,但这些方法往往适合具体的解剖或模式,限制了跨临床环境的一般化,并留有改进的余地。 最近的基因模型显示了结构分解任务的迭代预测的好处,然而基于扩散的方法受到计算成本昂贵的采样的影响,阻碍了它们在高分辨率3D卷上的使用. 我们提出3D-CurvSegFlow,一个基于流匹配的3D曲率结构分割模型. 该模型学习了从简单的源分布到目标血管表达的连续转变,使得能够以高效推论逐步完善复杂的曲面几何. 我们用三种具有挑战性的公开数据集评估我们的方法,这些数据集涉及不同的解剖和模式:门户静脉、大脑血管和冠脉。 在所有任务中采用共同的架构和培训战略,我们的方法比一般目的和船只特有的方法要好,要有力保存细枝节和血管连续性。 这项工作不仅推进了3D曲维线分解的先进水平,还为医疗图像分析中高效,通俗,临床应用的方法开辟了新的途径.

articles.title: AvatarDynamizer: From Static to Dynamic Human Avatars via Generative Dynamic Textures
articles.content: For full-body avatars, modeling surface dynamics is crucial for overcoming the uncanny valley and achieving perceptual realism. Person-agnostic methods recover static 3D avatars from monocular images, videos, or text prompts, but their skeleton-driven animations lack realistic surface dynamics such as clothing wrinkles. In contrast, person-specific methods achieve high-quality rendering and realistic dynamics, but require expensive multi-view captures for each individual. Recent generalizable dynamic avatar methods struggle to embed surface dynamics, leading to either limited multi-view consistency or dynamic expressiveness. To this end, we propose AvatarDynamizer, a generative method that transforms an off-the-shelf static 3D avatar into a controllable, realistic, and multi-view-consistent 4D avatar. We introduce a novel texture-space surface-dynamics embedding and formulate avatar dynamics modeling as conditional texture generation. Our encoder--decoder representation embeds pose-dependent dynamics into dynamic texture maps, enabling compatibility with pre-trained video diffusion models while decoding them into 3D Gaussians for multi-view consistent rendering. Since existing datasets are limited in scale, sequence length, or motion diversity, we collect a large-scale multi-view dataset with long sequences covering diverse skeletal motions and surface dynamics. Experiments show that our method effectively animates static avatars with faithful surface dynamics and outperforms competing generalizable methods in visual fidelity, especially under limited dynamic training data.

articles.title_zh: 阿凡达定音器 : 通过基因动态纹理从静态到动态人类神通
articles.content_zh: 对于全身的阿凡达人来说,模拟表面动态对于克服不光彩的山谷,实现知觉现实主义至关重要. 人物-不可知论方法从单视图像,视频,或文字提示中恢复静态的3D异形,但其骨架驱动的动画缺乏现实的表面动态,如衣物皱纹. 相比之下,针对个人的方法实现了高质量的渲染和现实的动态,但需要对每个人进行昂贵的多视图捕捉. 近代通俗的动态变异方法为嵌入表面动态而挣扎,导致多视一致性或动态表达性有限. 为此,我们提出AvatarDynamize,一种将现成的静态3D变形器转化为可控,现实,多景相容的4D变形器的基因方法. 我们引入一种新型的纹理-空间表面-动力学嵌入并形成阿凡达动力学模型,作为有条件的纹理生成. 我们的编码器-解码器表示器嵌入了动态纹理图中的可依赖动态,能够与预先训练的视频传播模型兼容,同时将其解码为3D高斯语,用于多视图一致渲染. 由于现有的数据集在尺度,序列长度,或运动多样性上是有限的,因此我们收集了具有长序列的大规模多视图数据集,涵盖了不同的骨骼运动和表面动态. 实验表明,我们的方法有效地使具有忠实表面动态的静态动画动画,在视觉忠心性方面,特别是在有限的动态训练数据下,其性能超过了相互竞争的通用方法.

articles.title: Unified and Efficient Point-Line Local Features
articles.content: Multi-view computer vision pipelines typically rely on accurate sparse keypoints and robust descriptors. While incorporating line features has shown clear benefits for matching and pose estimation, existing point-line approaches remain inefficient: they detect points and lines separately, use increasingly heavy networks, and depend on CPU-bound heuristics that hinder real-time performance. We introduce a Unified Efficient Points and Lines (UPAL) feature extractor that jointly extracts keypoints, line segments, and feature descriptors within a single lightweight architecture. A shared backbone provides common representations that feed different branches for point and line features. Line segments are recovered through an accelerated post-processing stage, an enhanced and highly efficient variant of the LSD algorithm. UPAL matches or exceeds state-ofthe-art performance in both point and line applications while significantly reducing computational cost, achieving, for instance, a 4x speedup and 10x smaller memory footprint over the ALIKED + DeepLSD pipeline. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/francois141/upal.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 统一和高效的点线局部特征
articles.content_zh: 多视图计算机视觉管道通常依赖于准确的零星键点和强健的描述符. 纳入线面特征在匹配和提出估计方面显示出明显的好处,但现有的点面方法仍然效率低下:它们分别检测点面和线面,使用越来越重的网络,并依赖CPU约束的houristics阻碍实时性能. 我们引入了统一高效点和线(UPAL)特性提取器,在单一轻量级架构内联合提取键点,线段和特征描述符. 共享骨干提供共同的表示,为点和线特性提供不同分支的反馈. 线段通过一个加速的后处理阶段,即LSD算法的增强型和高度高效的变体进行回收. UPAL匹配或超过点和线应用中最先进的性能,同时大幅降低计算成本,例如,在ALIKED + DeepLSD管道上实现4x加速和10x较小的内存足迹. 守则可在https://github.com/francois141/upal上公开查阅。

articles.title: DIFFCZSL: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning Regularized by Diffusion Representations
articles.content: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) aims to recognize unseen attribute-object compositions by leveraging knowledge of primitive concepts learned from seen compositions. Although recent works achieve impressive performance in CZSL by leveraging large vision-language models, they primarily rely on discriminative representations that may not explicitly preserve the structured relationships between primitive concepts and their compositions. Motivated by the recent success of diffusion-based classifiers and their competitive performance relative to discriminative models, we investigate whether intermediate diffusion representations can provide complementary cues for CZSL. To this end, we propose DIFFCZSL, a diffusion-augmented framework that injects generative priors from pre-trained diffusion models into CLIP-based CZSL pipelines. We extract intermediate diffusion representations and project them into the CLIP embedding space to provide auxiliary supervision on both image and text modalities. Through contrastive alignment between CLIP embeddings and diffusion features during training, our method encourages the embedding geometry toward richer composition-aware semantics, while introducing no additional cost at inference time. Extensive experiments on three public CZSL benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CLIP-based baselines under both closed-world and open-world settings. Our results highlight the complementary strengths of generative diffusion representations and discriminative vision-language models for compositional generalization.

articles.title_zh: DIFFCZSL: 由分散表达法规范化的构成性零热学习
articles.content_zh: 组成学 Zero-Shot Learning(CZSL)旨在通过利用从所见组成学中汲取的原始概念知识来识别无形的属性-对象组成学. 虽然近期的作品通过利用大型视觉语言模型在CZSL中取得了令人印象深刻的性能,但它们主要依赖于可能没有明确保留原始概念与其构成之间结构化关系的歧视性表述. 由于基于扩散的分类器最近取得了成功,而且相对于歧视性模型而言,它们的表现具有竞争力,我们调查中间扩散表示能否为CZSL提供补充提示。 为此,我们提议DIFFCZSL,一种扩散强化框架,从预先训练的传播模型中将基因前序注入基于CLIP的CZSL管道. 我们提取中间扩散表示并投射到CLIP嵌入空间中,以提供图像和文本模式的辅助监督. 通过将CLIP嵌入与培训过程中的传播特征进行对比一致,我们的方法鼓励嵌入几何学走向更丰富的构象-感知语义学,同时在推论时不增加成本。 对三个公开的CZSL基准进行的广泛试验表明,在封闭世界和开放世界环境下,与基于CLIP的强大基线相比,不断改进。 我们的成果突出了基因传播表达和构成概括的歧视性视觉语言模型的互补优势。

articles.title: A 360-Degree Vision Dataset for Learning Yaw Control on GPS-Denied Micro-UAVs in Disaster-Response-Relevant Environments
articles.content: This paper presents a novel data-driven approach to camera-based autonomy for micro-drones in GPS-denied, radio-challenging indoor environments. The target application is disaster and emergency response, where micro-UAVs can provide rapid situational awareness in hazardous settings such as firefighting and chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) incidents while reducing risk for human responders. When the communication link is lost, the micro-drone uses a learned yaw controller to autonomously navigate toward open space, preserving onboard sensor data that would otherwise be lost with the vehicle. A custom micro-drone equipped with a 360-degree camera was used to record diverse industrial, underground, and training scenarios representative of communication-denied field operations. We introduce a preprocessing pipeline that converts equirectangular 360-degree footage into planar front views and dynamically generates image-label pairs for AI training. We then train and compare multiple convolutional neural network variants that predict a continuous yaw command from a single monocular view. Evaluation on a held-out test set confirms the feasibility of the learned yaw-prediction approach. A semi-autonomous real-world test further demonstrates the practicality of the method while revealing key failure modes, particularly reflections and glare.

articles.title_zh: 一个360-Degree Vision数据集,用于在灾害应对和关联环境中学习GPS-Denied微紫外线控制
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的数据驱动方法,用于GPS所拒绝的、对无线电挑战的室内环境中的微型机器人的相机自主性。 目标应用是灾害和应急反应,在消防、化学、生物、辐射和核(化学、生物、核)事故等危险环境下,微型无人驾驶飞行器可提供快速的态势意识,同时降低人类应对人员的风险。 当通信链路丢失时,微波管使用一个学习的yaw控制器自动导航到开放的空间,保存本会随飞行器丢失的机载传感器数据. 一套装有360度照相机的定制微龙用于记录各种工业、地下和培训场景,这些场景代表通信被拒的外地业务。 我们引入了预处理管道,将平方360度的镜头转换成平面前视,并动态生成图像标签对,用于AI训练. 然后我们训练并比较了多个演化神经网络变体,这些变体从一个单一的视角预测出一个连续的yaw指令. 对搁置测试集的评价证实了所学的黄道预测方法的可行性。 一种半自主的现实世界测试进一步证明了方法的实用性,同时揭示了关键故障模式,特别是反射和闪光.

articles.title: AutoLumNet: Monotone Optimal Transport for Single-Shot Exposure Correction
articles.content: Single-shot exposure correction aims to map an arbitrarily degraded image---whether under-exposed, over-exposed, or a spatial mixture of both---to a well-exposed output from a single capture. We present AutoLumNet, a framework that decomposes this task into a global monotone tone curve and a bounded local residual, making the global component the locus of formal guarantees. The tone curve is parameterized as the normalized cumulative integral of a strictly positive density, ensuring strict monotonicity by construction rather than by penalty. We prove that this parameterization (i)~preserves the pairwise luminance ordering of all pixels and all spatial extrema unconditionally, and (ii)~is dense in the space of valid tone corrections, containing the one-dimensional optimal-transport map from the input to any target luminance distribution. A differentiable sorted-sample Wasserstein-2 objective drives the learned curve toward the OT optimum during training. Spatially varying effects that the global map provably cannot address---local shading, chrominance shifts, and clipped-region restoration---are handled by a bounded residual decoder with dual-branch convex fusion, for which we provide an explicit sufficient condition for local order preservation. Experiments on five benchmarks (MSEC, SICE, LCDP, LOL-v1, LOL-v2-real) show that AutoLumNet achieves state-of-the-art PSNR and SSIM across both under- and over-exposure regimes at 11.2\,ms per frame, and generalizes zero-shot to pure low-light benchmarks without retraining. To our knowledge, AutoLumNet is the first exposure-correction method to unite structural monotonicity, optimal-transport optimality, and bounded local adaptivity within a single trainable architecture. Code is available at https://github.com/kraihan/Autolumnet.
