articles.title_zh: Daedalus-150M: 为CPU设计的一种革命-留心混合型 推论
articles.content_zh:
小语言模型通常像大语言模型一样被构建,然后被挤到之后的CPU上. 我们做了相反的事情:我们首先固定了目标,一个用户,一个符号一次,4位重量,普通CPU,并且选择了适合它的架构. 结果在18个街区中,只有6个街区充分关注。 其他12个则使用短的分解,无论对话持续多久,其记忆都是宽于两个时间步的,因此三分之二的网络从未再读出一个越来越大的缓存.
在59.9B令牌上从零开始训练,该型号在5个任务基准上得分47.31分,而训练开始前固定的栏杆为42.20分. 它击败了GPT-2 124M,Pythia-160M,OPP-125M和GPT-neo-125M,都接受了多出三到六倍数据的培训,并超越了MobileLLM-125M公布的分数,尽管该模型看到了一兆个符. 验证比特-每字节为0.8685.
为了检查建筑而不是训练秘方 我们用同样的数据 训练了一个传统的全心全意模式 并在评分前写下胜负条件 混合体以0.81%赢得了所选的质量度量衡,在下游任务上与之相匹配,生成了6.3%的更小的4位文件,并在上下文的2048个符号上解码速度快了1.76x,2.08x与大小相仿的外型. 在每一次测量中,速度优势在空上下文中接近零并随长度而增长,这是机制预测的,而仅仅是更收缩的模型不会显示的. 简单的带宽计算只预测出1.17x,因此仅内存体积并不能解释差距.
我们还报告一些不起作用的东西:一种未减的4位质量成本, 大约一半的演化通道最后是惰性的,无法去除, 以及一个比这个模型大小更大的词汇。

articles.title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts
articles.content: Legal work, with its heavy reliance on processing large amounts of text, is often considered one of the domains most exposed to the use of LLMs. Contract ``scrubbing,'' the final review of transactional agreements for errors and inconsistencies, is a particularly suitable task for automation, because it is routine, painstaking work requiring detailed attention to long documents. Scrubbing also seems to align naturally with the general capabilities expected of frontier LLMs around long-context reasoning, consistency checking, and named entity recognition (NER). Despite the economic value and potential for automation, no formal evaluations of LLMs performing contract scrubbing have been conducted. We introduce ContractScrub, the first benchmark designed to evaluate contract scrubbing capabilities, comprising contracts hand-crafted by experienced lawyers over diverse error categories such as misuse of defined terms, incorrect references, and inconsistent language. Frontier models perform surprisingly poorly with only one model reaching 0.75 macro average recall despite strong performance on seemingly related general benchmarks, demonstrating the practical limits of current models and the importance of narrowly targeted, domain-specific benchmarks for measuring real-world impact.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 合同扫描 : 法律合同最后审查的基准
articles.content_zh: 法律工作严重依赖大量文本的处理,因此常常被认为是最容易被使用有限责任公司的领域之一。 对交易协议进行最后审查,以确定错误和不一致之处,这是自动化的一项特别合适的任务,因为它是例行而艰苦的工作,需要详细注意冗长的文件。 冲洗似乎也自然符合边界有限责任公司在长文推理、一致性核对和命名实体识别(NER)方面预期的一般能力。 尽管自动化具有经济价值和潜力,但没有对有限责任公司进行合同清理进行正式评价。 我们采用ContractScrub,这是第一个旨在评价合同擦除能力的基准,包括由有经验的律师手工制作的合同,涉及各种错误类别,如滥用界定的术语、不正确的引用和不一致的语言。 边疆模型的表现令人惊讶地很差,只有一个模型达到了0.75宏观平均回顾,尽管在看似相关的一般基准方面表现强劲,这表明了目前模型的实际局限性,以及衡量现实世界影响的狭隘的、针对具体领域的基准的重要性。

articles.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
articles.content: Memory has become a key component of large language models, enabling them to retain information and learn from long-term interactions. However, existing memory benchmarks mainly evaluate whether information is correctly extracted, stored, and retrieved, while largely overlooking how retrieved memories reshape model reasoning and affect performance on the current task. We identify memory-induced cognitive traps: even faithfully recorded and semantically relevant memories can distort model reasoning or beliefs and degrade current task performance. To systematically evaluate these failure modes, we introduce MemTrapBench, which covers two forms of cognitive traps: Reasoning Fixation and Belief Distortion. Experiments across two model families and five representative memory frameworks show that MemTrapBench is challenging: all evaluated memory strategies underperform the no-memory setting, with even the strongest methods suffering drops of more than 10%. To mitigate these cognitive traps, we propose AdaptiveMem, a simple yet effective inference-time method that instructs LLMs to avoid memory traps. AdaptiveMem mitigates cognitive traps on MemTrapBench while preserving or improving performance on standard memory benchmarks across diverse memory frameworks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MemTrap Bench: LLM 内存使用中认知陷阱的基准化
articles.content_zh: 记忆已经成为了大型语言模型的关键组成部分,使其能够保留信息并学习长期互动. 然而,现有的内存基准主要评价信息是否正确提取,存储和检索,同时在很大程度上忽略了被检索的记忆如何重塑模型推理,并影响当前任务的表现. 我们识别出由记忆所引发的认知陷阱:即使忠实地被记录下来并且与记忆紧密相关,也会扭曲模型推理或信念并降低当前任务性能. 为了系统地评估这些失败模式,我们引入了MemTrap Bench,它涵盖了两种认知陷阱: 理性修行与正信扭曲. 跨越两个模型家族和五个代表性记忆框架的实验表明,MemTrap Bench具有挑战性:所有被评价的记忆策略都表现不佳于无记忆设定,即使是最强的方法也遭受了超过10%的下降. 为了减轻这些认知陷阱,我们提出"适应Mem"(Adaptive Mem),这是一种简单而有效的推论时间方法,它指示LLMs避免内存陷阱. 适应Mem减轻了MemTrap Bench上的认知陷阱,同时保留或改进不同内存框架中标准内存基准的性能.

articles.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
articles.content: We present a novel approach to efficient LLM agent harness optimization through adaptive validation task selection. Harness optimization iteratively rewrites the harness code based on validation performance, enabling substantial performance gains without updating the underlying model weights. Existing approaches, however, evaluate a fixed validation set in full at every iteration, incurring substantial evaluation costs even on tasks that become less discriminative as the harness evolves. We propose $\textbf{Task-CoEvolve}$, which co-evolves the validation tasks with the harness by addressing two challenges: selecting informative tasks and estimating full-set performance from partial evaluations. Task-CoEvolve builds on the observation that tasks on which candidate harnesses disagree are more informative for distinguishing among them than tasks that are consistently solved or failed. It uses variance-weighted sampling based on past outcomes to focus evaluation on tasks near the agent's capability frontier, with the sampling distribution adapting as the harness evolves. It then estimates full-set scores from the sampled tasks by accounting for their sampling probabilities, enabling consistent comparisons across iterations despite evaluating different subsets. Experiments on online text classification and Terminal-Bench 2.1 show that Task-CoEvolve consistently outperforms fixed-subset baselines and matches the final performance of full-set search while reducing the number of evaluations during optimization by 80%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Agent4Science-UTokyo/Task-CoEvolve.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 任务协同:通过适应性验证任务选择实现高效优化
articles.content_zh: 我们通过适应性验证任务选择,提出了高效LLM剂利用优化的新办法。 Harness最优化会以验证性能为基础,迭代地重写取带码,使得在不更新基本模型权重的情况下,能够取得实质性的性能收益. 然而,现有办法对每个周期的固定验证进行全面评价,甚至对随着利用情况的发展而变得不那么具有歧视性的任务也造成大量评价费用。 我们提出$\textbf{任务-共同演变}$,通过解决两个挑战,共同完成验证任务:选择信息性任务和从部分评价中估算整套业绩。 任务 - 欧洲委员会伏特加认为,候选人不同意的任务比一贯解决或失败的任务更能说明问题。 它利用基于以往结果的差异加权取样,把评价的重点放在靠近物剂能力前沿的任务上,随着取样装置的发展,采样分布也有所适应。 然后,它通过计算抽样概率,对抽样任务的全定分数作出估计,从而能够对不同子集进行一致的迭代比较。 关于在线文本分类和终端-Bench 2.1的实验显示,Text-Covolve始终超越了固定子集基线,与全集搜索的最终性能相匹配,同时在优化期间将评价次数减少80%. 守则将在https://github.com/Agent4Science-UTokyo/Task-Covolve上发布。

articles.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have shown growing potential for automated theoretical computer science (TCS) research, yet existing benchmarks remain far from realistic research settings. We introduce \ourbenchmark, an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on frontier, end-to-end TCS research. \ourbenchmark contains $175$ instances drawn from papers accepted to STOC, FOCS, SODA, and COLT in 2025-2026, preserving paper-specific definitions, assumptions, and proof dependencies, with expert-verified Lean formalizations and proofs. Evaluations of leading LLMs reveal that current models remain far from reliably completing the full research pipeline. In particular, autoformalization is the sharpest bottleneck: the best model achieves only $11.5$ on translating natural-language claims into formal theorem statements, compared with $28.6$ Pass@8 when proving human-provided formal statements. Building on \ourbenchmark, we further develop an automated TCS research framework that generates, formalizes, filters, and proves new claims. Of $64$ generated claims, only $6$ ultimately pass expert evaluation and proof verification, indicating that beyond formalization, limited research taste remains another major barrier to autonomous TCS research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 正规TCS:对大语言模型的端到端正规理论计算机科学研究的基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)显示自动化理论计算机科学(TCS)研究的潜力越来越大,但现有的基准仍然远远没有现实的研究环境. 我们引入了\我们的基准,这是一个经过专家认证的基准,用于评估前沿、端到端的TCS研究。 \我们的基准标记包含从2025至2026年接受STOC,FOCS,SODA,和COLT的论文中提取的175美元实例,保留了纸上特有的定义,假设和证明的依赖性,并有经过专家验证的Lean形式化和证明. 对主要有限责任公司的评价表明,目前的模型仍然远远没有可靠地完成全部研究程序。 特别是,自动形式化是最尖锐的瓶颈:最佳模式在将自然语言索赔翻译成正式定理陈述方面只获得11.5美元,而在证明人提供的正式陈述时则获得28.6美元Pass@8美元. 在\我们的基准的基础上,我们进一步发展了一个自动TCS研究框架,这个框架可以生成,正规化,过滤,并证明新的主张. 在产生的64美元索赔中,只有6美元最终通过专家评价和证明核实,表明除了正规化之外,有限的研究品味仍然是自主的TCS研究的另一个主要障碍。

articles.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration with the Common-Sense Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs for Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Autonomous vehicles require robust perception and decision-making capabilities to operate in diverse and unseen scenarios. While reinforcement learning and rule-based methods can provide effective control and safety mechanisms, their performance may degrade in situations requiring contextual reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding multimodal information and generating contextual reasoning, however, their use for direct vehicle control can introduce latency and hallucination risks. To address these limitations, a hybrid framework is proposed. This system uses an orchestrator to coordinate PPO-trained reinforcement learning and PID control, with LLM common-sense reasoning applied throughout the framework. LLM reasoning is further employed iteratively to refine the RL reward function for dynamic driving environments. The proposed framework is evaluated in highly randomized CARLA scenarios under diverse environmental and traffic conditions. The results demonstrate the potential of integrating LLM-based reasoning with conventional autonomous driving methods while retaining structured control and safety mechanism.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多代理管弦乐团与自主驾驶LLMS的常识理性能力
articles.content_zh: 自主的车辆需要有强有力的感知和决策能力,以便在各种不为人知的情况下运作。 虽然加强学习和基于规则的方法可以提供有效的控制和安全机制,但在需要背景推理的情况下,其性能可能会下降。 大语言模型(LLMS)在理解多式联运信息并产生背景推理方面表现出了强大的能力,但是,将其用于直接的车辆控制可带来延迟和幻觉风险。 为了克服这些局限性,建议建立一个混合框架。 这个系统使用一个管弦乐器来协调PPO训练的强化学习和PID控制,全框架应用LLM常识推理. LLM推理被进一步反复使用,以完善动态驱动环境的RL奖励功能. 在各种环境和交通条件下,对拟议框架进行了高度随机化的CARLA情景评价。 结果表明,在保留结构化控制和安全机制的同时,有可能将基于LLM的推理与传统的自主驾驶方法相结合。

articles.title: When Text and Numbers Disagree: Evidence Arbitration in Large Language Models
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in settings where textual summaries, numerical observations, and external tool outputs may provide conflicting evidence. We study how LLMs arbitrate between such sources when they support opposing decisions. To do so, we introduce a controlled synthetic benchmark in which latent risk trajectories generate both numerical time series and natural language summaries, allowing us to construct conflicts where exactly one evidence source is aligned with the ground-truth label. This design lets us independently manipulate modality, temporal recency, source reliability, and evidence provenance. Across open-weight instruction-tuned models, we find that arbitration behaviour is systematic rather than random: models exhibit distinct text-versus-number preferences, follow temporal recency more consistently than explicit reliability cues, and can over-rely on external forecasts even when they conflict with direct contextual evidence. These results suggest that current LLMs often rely on heuristic arbitration strategies when integrating heterogeneous evidence, highlighting a failure mode for tool-augmented decision systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 文本和数字分歧:大语文模型证据仲裁
articles.content_zh: 在文本摘要、数字观察和外部工具输出可能提供相冲突证据的环境下,越来越多地使用大语言模型。 我们研究这些来源之间当它们支持相反的决定时,它们如何仲裁。 为此,我们采用了一个控制下的合成基准,其中潜在的风险轨迹既生成数字时间序列,又生成自然语言摘要,使我们能够构建冲突,使一个证据来源与地面-真实标签一致。 这种设计让我们可以独立地操纵模式,时间调整,源的可靠性,以及证据的来源. 我们发现,在开放加权指示调整的模型中,仲裁行为是系统性的,而不是随机的:模型表现出不同的文字和数字偏好,比明确的可靠性提示更一致地遵循时间调整,即使外部预测与直接的上下文证据相冲突,也可以过于真实。 这些结果表明,目前的有限责任公司在整合各种证据时往往依赖热力仲裁战略,突出了工具强化决策系统的失败模式。

articles.title: OenoBench: A Wine-Domain Benchmark for Knowledge-Grounded Evaluation of Large Language Models
articles.content: We introduce OenoBench, a wine-domain knowledge benchmark of 3,266 multiple-choice questions across six pillars (regions, grape varieties, viticulture, winemaking, producers, business) and four difficulty tiers. The corpus is built from 38,104 atomic, source-anchored facts extracted by 35 provenance-verified scrapers from government registries (INAO, TTB, OIV), peer-reviewed journals, and Wikipedia/Wikidata. Our methodological contribution is an LLM-driven pipeline in which language models reformat verified facts and audit the result, but never serve as the source of truth: every claim traces to a URL, every question is generated by one of five strategies across five generator families, and every question is scored by a nine-agent audit calibrated against a human gold sheet via Cohen's $κ$. Evaluating sixteen frontier configurations, we find: (i) overall accuracy spans 53%-84%, led by o3 at 83.6%; (ii) reasoning-mode lift concentrates in DeepSeek R1 (+6.8pp) and is absent in Claude Opus and Gemini Pro; (iii) Anthropic shows +9pp self preference on its own questions while Google shows -8pp inverse preference; (iv) frontier open-weight models share the cost-vs-accuracy Pareto frontier with proprietary reasoning models; and (v) every config gains around 33pp on closed-book solvable items, revealing a parametric-recall ceiling that only the contextual slice avoids. We release corpus, audit findings, human-review app, and construction code under CC-BY-SA-4.0.

articles.title: Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation for Efficient Multi-Agent Communication Topology Design
articles.content: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by coordinating multiple agents, but at the cost of substantial token consumption. Recent work on automatic topology design, ARG-Designer, has reframed this problem as autoregressive graph generation. However, its training objective provides no explicit incentive for the model to generate sparse and efficient topologies. We address this limitation by introducing a Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation (RGA-Designer) inspired by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We train a reward model that jointly captures task correctness and structural compactness, and then fine-tune the pretrained graph generator using the reward model as feedback. Our method preserves task accuracy at the level of ARG-Designer while reducing token consumption by an average of 20.5%.

articles.title_zh: 为高效多代理通信地形设计提供奖励的自动递归图生成
articles.content_zh: 基于LLM的多代理系统(MAS)通过协调多代理,在复杂的推理任务上取得了强大的性能,但以大量象征性消费为代价. 最近关于自动地貌设计(ARG-Designer)的工作将这个问题重新定义为自相回转的图形生成. 然而,其培训目标并没有为模型产生稀少而高效的地貌提供明确的激励. 我们通过采用由加强从人类反馈中学习启发的奖励指导自动递减图生成(RGA-Designer)来解决这一限制。 我们训练一种奖励模型,共同捕捉任务正确性和结构紧凑性,然后利用奖励模型作为反馈来微调预先训练过的图表生成器. 我们的方法保留了ARG-设计师一级的任务精度,同时将象征性消费平均减少20.5%.

articles.title: SABET-QA: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
articles.content: Question Answering over Temporal Knowledge Graphs (TKGQA) requires reasoning over time-sensitive facts, yet existing embedding-based methods struggle with multi-step queries due to single-pass reasoning pipelines. We propose SABET-QA, a framework that iteratively refines reasoning states across multiple hops via a bidirectional entity-temporal scoring mechanism and a slot-aware contextualization module that aligns question semantics with temporal KG embeddings. A differentiable working memory enables progressive hypothesis refinement, while auxiliary temporal boundaries serve as coarse supervision when available. Experiments on CronQuestions, Complex-CronQuestions, MultiTQ, and TimeQuestions demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, particularly on complex multi-step temporal queries.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SABET-QA:临时知识图解答问题
articles.content_zh: 提问回答超时空知识图(TKGQA)需要针对时间敏感的事实进行推理,然而由于单通推理管道,现有的嵌入式方法与多步骤的询问相冲突. 我们提出SABET-QA,这个框架通过双向实体-时态评分机制,通过双向实体-时态评分机制,迭代地完善了跨多跳的推理状态,以及将问题语义与时态KG嵌入联系起来的时位感上下文化模块. 不同的工作记忆可以使假说逐渐得到完善,而辅助时间界限在可用时充当粗细的监督. 关于CronQuestions,Complex-CronQuestions,MultiTQ,和TimeQuestions的实验显示,在强基线上,特别是在复杂的多步骤时间查询上,不断有改进.

articles.title: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
articles.content: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures significantly expand model capacity without a proportional increase in computational cost. However, optimizing their hyperparameters---particularly the learning rate---at extreme scales of both model size and token budget via sweeping remains computationally prohibitive. In this paper, we propose a compute-efficient, two-step hyperparameter transfer framework that estimates optimal learning rates for training large MoE models by transferring them across scaling model widths, and subsequently extrapolating to trillion-token horizons. First, we formulate a Maximal Update Parameterization ($μ$P) adaptation for MoE architectures utilizing Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and the Muon optimizer, demonstrating that optimal learning rates transfer consistently across width-scaled models. Second, we extend this transferability along the token dimension by establishing a predictive scaling law. By applying linear regression to the optimal values derived from small proxy models on limited budgets, we successfully extrapolate the ideal learning rate to massive training horizons (e.g., 10 trillion tokens) with high fidelity ($R^2=0.95$). Consequently, this indicates that proxy training on small models is sufficient to determine the optimal learning rate for the extensive training of large-scale MoEs. We apply the proposed methodology to pretrain our foundation model (155B total, 17B active parameters) from scratch, and the stable training and evaluation results validate that optimal configurations for full-scale target models can be accurately predicted with minimal ablation costs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 让我们一步步的缩放: 计算- 有效超参数传输, 用于大型的混合操作
articles.content_zh: Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)架构在不按比例地增加计算成本的情况下大幅扩展模型容量. 然而,优化其超参数,特别是学习率,在模型大小和象征性预算的极端尺度上,在计算上仍然令人望而却步。 在本文中,我们提出一个计算效率高,双步高的超参数传输框架,通过跨模型宽度的跨度传输,估算培训大型MOE模型的最佳学习率,并随后推算出万亿个地平线. 首先,我们利用多头Latent Content(MLA)和Muon优化器,为教育部建筑设计了最大更新参数化(μ$P),表明最佳学习率在宽度模型之间一致转移。 第二,我们通过制定预测性比例法,将这种可转让性延伸至象征层面。 通过将线性回归应用于有限预算的小型代用模型所衍生出的最佳值,我们成功地将理想的学习率推向具有高忠诚度(R^2=0.95美元)的大规模训练地平线(如10万亿令牌). 因此,这表明关于小型模型的代理培训足以确定大规模教育部广泛培训的最佳学习率。 我们采用拟议方法,从头开始对基础模型(155B总参数,17B活性参数)进行初步培训,稳定的培训和评价结果证明,可以精确地预测全面目标模型的最佳配置,同时降低消耗成本。

articles.title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
articles.content: Watermarking schemes for large language model output are evaluated almost exclusively on English text using each scheme's detection threshold and a narrow set of quality measurements. Multilingual deployment exposes evaluation-design choices that are inconsequential on English but determine conclusions cross-lingually. We propose an evaluation framework with four components: detection thresholds calibrated empirically per deployment context, a threshold-independent companion measurement that distinguishes calibration failures from detection failures, three disjoint quality measurement paradigms (distributional, paired-semantic, and reference-perplexity), and a generalized-entropy decomposition of cross-language disparity over a typological family partition. Applied to six watermarking schemes, three open-weight generators, eleven languages spanning four scripts and eight typological families, and both base and instruction-tuned regimes, the framework reveals failure modes that single-language single-paradigm evaluation cannot surface. Across detection and quality, observed disparity is predominantly between-family on the typological partition, indicating that cross-lingual fairness gaps in watermarking are structural to language properties rather than idiosyncratic to particular languages.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语文模式水标的横向公平
articles.content_zh: 对大型语言模型产出的水分标记方案几乎完全在英文文本上加以评价,使用每种方案的检测阈值和一套狭窄的质量测量。 多语种部署暴露了评价-设计选择,这些选择对英语没有影响,但会交叉语言决定结论. 我们提出了一个包括四个组成部分的评价框架:检测阈值按每次部署的情况按经验校正、区分校正故障与检测故障的阈值独立的伴行计量、三个不相干的质量计量范式(分布式、配对-语义和参考-复杂性),以及跨语种差异与类型性家族分化之间的普遍-内分解。 该框架适用于6个水分标记计划、3个开口发电机、11个语言,涉及4个脚本和8个打字家庭,以及基础和教学调整制度,揭示了单一语言单一参数评价不能浮出水面的失败模式。 在整个检测和质量方面,观察到的差别主要是在类型划分上的家庭之间的差别,这表明在水标记方面的跨语言公平性差距是语言特性的结构,而不是特定语言的特异性。

articles.title: HealMed: Multilingual Evaluation of Large Language Models in Medicine
articles.content: We present HealMed, an expert-reviewed benchmark for multilingual evaluation of large language models in medicine. HealMed contains 1,000 examples in each of nine languages, drawn from nine datasets and covering three task formats: MCQA, NLI and open-ended QA. The benchmark was developed over two years by 23 physicians and medical experts based across nine countries and regions. Each translation was evaluated and revised by two experts fluent in English and the corresponding target language. On HealMed, performance declined most in low-resource languages, although the size of the gap varied markedly across languages and models. The strongest proprietary models were the most stable across languages, whereas many open-source and medically specialized models showed larger and less consistent gaps. Medical specialization alone did not ensure multilingual robustness. Furthermore, expert revision could either raise or lower measured performance, indicating that translation quality materially affects cross-language evaluation results.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 治愈:医学大语言模型的多语言评价
articles.content_zh: 我们提出HealMed,这是医学大语言模型多语种评价的专家审查基准。 HealMed包含有从9个数据集中抽取的1000个以9个语言各取出的例子,并涵盖了三种任务格式:MCQA,NLI和可自由参加的QA. 该基准由设在9个国家和地区的23名医生和医疗专家在两年内制定。 每一份翻译都由两名精通英语和相应目标语言的专家进行评价和修订。 在HealMed上,低资源语言的性能下降幅度最大,尽管不同语言和模式的差距大小明显不同. 最强的专有模式是各语文间最稳定的模式,而许多开源和医学专业模式显示出较大和不太一致的差距。 仅靠医疗专业化并不能确保多语种的活力。 此外,专家修订可提高或降低衡量的业绩,表明翻译质量对跨语文评价结果有实质性影响。

articles.title: Robust Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis via Iterative Proxy Correction
articles.content: Multimodal sentiment analysis aims to infer affective states by integrating language, visual, and acoustic cues. However, real-world multimodal inputs are often incomplete or corrupted, which can weaken cross-modal complementarity and introduce misleading information into downstream fusion. Existing proxy-based methods for incomplete MSA commonly rely on one-shot proxy construction to compensate for degraded language information, but the generated proxy may be coarse or unreliable at initialization. Prematurely injecting such a proxy into multimodal reasoning can propagate initial errors and compromise sentiment prediction. To address this limitation, we propose an iterative proxy correction framework for robust incomplete MSA. Our method constructs a language-oriented proxy from non-language modalities and progressively refines it under multimodal context through gated residual correction. The corrected proxy is then adaptively fused with the observed language representation according to an estimated language reliability score, allowing the model to balance proxy-based compensation and trustworthy linguistic evidence. In addition, we introduce a stage-wise latent correction objective that uses the complete language representation as a training-time semantic anchor to stabilize the proxy refinement trajectory. Extensive experiments on MOSI, MOSEI, and SIMS under diverse missing-modality settings demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms competitive baselines and achieves robust sentiment prediction under incomplete inputs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过迭代代修正进行强力不完全的多式联运感官分析
articles.content_zh: 多模式情绪分析旨在通过融合语言、视觉和声学提示来推断有影响的国家。 然而,现实世界的多模式投入往往不完整或腐败,这可能会削弱跨模式互补,将误导性信息引入下游聚变. 对不完整的MSA的现有代用方法通常依靠一发的代用构造来补偿已退化的语言信息,但生成的代用在初始化时可能粗糙或不可靠. 过早地向多式联运推理中注入这种代用物可能会传播初步错误并损害情绪预测。 为了消除这一局限性,我们提议为有力的不完整的特派任务生活津贴建立一个迭代代理更正框架。 我们的方法从非语言模式中构建出一种面向语言的代用方法,并通过有门的剩余校正,在多式联运背景下逐步加以完善。 然后根据语言可靠性的估计分数,将被更正的代用词与所观察到的语言代表词相适应地结合,使该模型能够平衡基于代用补偿和可信赖的语言证据. 此外,我们引入了一个阶段性潜在校正目标,将完整的语言表述作为培训时语义锚地,以稳定代理完善轨迹。 对MOSI、MOSEI和SIMS在各种缺失模式环境下进行的广泛试验表明,拟议的框架一贯超过竞争性基线,并在不完整的投入下实现稳健的情绪预测。

articles.title: Natural Language Code Retrieval for 1C:Enterprise: An Open Benchmark and Efficient Bi-Encoder
articles.content: Natural language code retrieval is a rapidly evolving task in computer science. However, the 1C:Enterprise ecosystem combines Russian syntax with highly domain-specific terminology, for which open datasets and specialized models have been virtually non-existent. We present a comprehensive pipeline for 1C code retrieval: an open benchmark of 3,413 real-world, PII-scrubbed query-code pairs, a reproducible evaluation harness, and a specialized bi-encoder. To overcome scarce labeled data, we fine-tune on 784,057 synthetic triplets generated by google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it from public code repositories, using Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) and a privacy-aware tokenizer. Because the benchmark subsets differ in size, we report balanced-subset macro, query-weighted micro, and forum-only results. Our model reaches 0.5992 balanced macro nDCG@10, 0.5044 micro, and 0.4617 on forum, versus 0.4932 macro for the baseline architecture and 0.5404 for google/embeddinggemma-300m. Removing every benchmark example flagged by the conservative exact/13-gram overlap audit leaves 0.6011 balanced macro (0.5010 micro), indicating that detected train-benchmark overlap does not explain the headline result. MRL truncation to 256 dimensions preserves 99.9% of retrieval quality while reducing dense-index storage and exact similarity arithmetic by a factor of three.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 1C 的自然语言代码检索: 企业: 一个开放的基准和高效双编码器
articles.content_zh: 自然语言代码检索是计算机科学中一项快速演变的任务. 然而,"1C:企业生态系统"将俄罗斯语法与高度域特有名词结合起来,为此,开放数据集和专用模型几乎不存在. 我们提出了1C代码检索的综合管道:3,413个真实世界的开放基准、PII-scrubbed查询码对、可复制的评价工具以及专用双编码器。 为了克服被贴上标签的稀缺数据,我们利用Matryoshka代表性学习(MRL)和一种对隐私有知觉的标语器,对公共代码存储器中由google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it生成的784,057个合成三胞胎进行了微调. 由于基准子集的大小不同,我们报告平衡子集宏,查询加权的微观和仅论坛的结果. 我们的模型达到0.5992个均衡的宏 nDCG@10, 0.5044个微观, 和0.4617个论坛, 而基线结构的宏为0.4932, 和google/embeddinggemma-300m的宏为0.54。 删除保守的精确13克重叠审计所标出的每一个基准实例,留下了0.6011个均衡的宏(0.5010个微观),表明检测到的列车-基准重叠并不能解释标题结果. MRL切入到256个维度中,保留了99.9%的检索质量,同时将稠密的索引存储量和精确的相近性算法减少3倍.

articles.title: Dynamic Gated Cross-Modal Fusion with Sarcastic-aware Contrastive Regularization for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
articles.content: Multimodal sarcasm detection aims to identify sarcastic intent from multimodal content, where inconsistencies between literal meaning and contextual cues often signal irony. This task has attracted increasing research attention. However, accurate detection remains challenging due to instance-dependent modality contributions and misleading semantic consistency, where surface-level alignment masks underlying contradictory intent. Existing methods often rely on fixed fusion strategies and treat sarcasm as generic cross-modal mismatch, limiting their ability to capture subtle sarcasm cues and instance-specific modality interactions. To address these challenges, we propose a novel MSD framework that integrates Dynamic Gated Cross-Modal Fusion with Sarcastic-aware Contrastive Regularization (SaCR). Specifically, a bidirectional gated interaction module performs cross-modal feature filtering and adaptively calibrates textual and visual contributions at the instance level. A dynamic fusion gate further balances modality importance to generate more robust multimodal representations. Furthermore, SaCR is introduced as a label-aware contrastive regularization objective that encourages semantic consistency for non-sarcastic samples while suppressing misleading consistency in sarcastic cases. The proposed framework is trained end-to-end with a multi-objective learning strategy that jointly optimizes multimodal classification and auxiliary unimodal supervision. Extensive experiments on MMSD and MMSD2.0 demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms strong baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 动态相模相模与相相模相模相模相相相配
articles.content_zh: 多式联运讽刺检测旨在从多式联运内容中识别讽刺意图,其中字面意义与上下文提示之间的不一致往往表明具有讽刺意味。 这项任务引起了越来越多的研究关注。 然而,准确的检测仍然具有挑战性,因为依赖实例模式的贡献和误导的语义一致性,表面水平的校正掩盖了自相矛盾的意图。 现有方法往往依靠固定的聚变策略,将讽刺视为通用的跨模式不匹配,限制了它们捕捉微妙的讽刺提示和特例模式互动的能力. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个新的MSD框架,将动态Gated Cross-Modal Fusion与Sarcastic-aware Contrastituation(SACR)相融合. 具体而言,双向门式互动模块在实例一级进行跨模式特性过滤并适应性地校准文字和视觉贡献。 动态聚变闸门进一步平衡模式的重要性,以产生更强有力的多式联运表述。 此外,SACR被作为具有标签意识的对比性规范化目标引入,它鼓励非沙体样本的语义一致性,同时抑制在讽刺性案例中的误导性一致性. 拟议的框架是经过培训的端到端,有多种目标学习战略,共同优化多式联运分类和辅助单一模式监督。 关于MMSD和MMSD2.0的广泛实验表明,拟议方法的绩效始终高于强基线。

articles.title: Learning how to Forget: Fine-tuning for Long-Context Sparse Attention
articles.content: A lot of prior work addressed key-value (KV) cache selection and compression by sparse attention to enable long-context inference for transformer language models without excessive hardware budgets. We provide a new method for fine-tuning models with sparse attention. It works for any KV cache policy, runs on a moderate hardware budget (e.g., a single Nvidia A100 GPU with 40 GB RAM), and allows the model to co-adapt with the policy, often outperforming models trained with exact attention (sequence parallelism). We also provide an efficient implementation of H2O sparse attention (the leading policy in our experiments) with dedicated scaled dot product attention kernel support. KeysAndValues (https://github.com/awslabs/keys_values), a new open source library for long-context inference and fine-tuning, provides easy-to-use and performant code for all methods discussed here.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习如何忘却:对长文的精细调整
articles.content_zh: 许多前作都通过很少的注意来解决了密钥-值(KV)缓存选择和压缩问题,使得变压器语言模型没有过多的硬件预算而能够进行长文本推导. 我们为微调模型提供了一种新的方法,很少受到关注。 它为任何KV缓存政策工作,运行在温和的硬件预算上(例如单个Nvidia A100 GPU有40 GB RAM),并允许模型与政策相配合适应,经常比训练得精准的模型(序列平行主义)要好. 我们还提供高效的H2O 稀有关注(我们实验中的主要政策),并有专门的大小点产品关注内核支持. KeysAndValues(https://github.com/awslabs/keys_values),是一个用于长文本推论和微调的新开源库,为本文所讨论出的所有方法提供了方便使用和表演的代码.

articles.title: Interrupting the Loop: Periodic Subject Changes Raise Judged Surprise and Connection in Base Language Models
articles.content: Where does the novelty a base language model produces with no task come from, and what can an LLM judge of a long stream actually see? We dismantle a cognitively inspired generation loop over 24 conditions on three base models. Most of its effect lives in one operation: a new subject injected every few hundred tokens (an interruption) into a stream whose literal repetition is damped (habituation). We judge windows of generated text only, with the premise as the unit (n=10) and a judge measured for repeatability, against a second judge family and against human readers. Under that protocol the interruption raises judged surprise by 1.2 to 1.4 points and connection by 0.8 over habituation alone. A connective that asks for continuity hurts; a bare paragraph break adds nothing detectable on fresh text; a reset context does at least as well as a kept one; and a pre-registered replication on new premises confirms the primary contrast. Three things the window judge could not see changed the first version of this study, and we think they are of general use. The judge scores the experimenter's injected sentence as the model's own. A fixed rotation of injected sentences makes the model replay its earlier segments from beyond the judge's horizon, and the judge scores the replay as surprise and connection (65-80% of post-interruption windows at periods 150-300). And the local gains do not compose: no arm produces an integrated document. The salience monitor, the in-loop judge, memory across interruptions and a judge-gated Review run with a gate that opens add nothing. On a problem with a verifier (online bin packing), the interruption multiplies valid, distinct candidate heuristics three- to fourfold without raising the quality of the best. We report an evaluation protocol for long generation and a controlled characterization of a simple intervention, not a mechanism of creativity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 中断循环: 周期性主题变化提高判断的惊喜和基本语言模型的连接
articles.content_zh: 一个基础语言模型的新颖性在哪里产生而无任务来自何处,一个长流的LLM判断者能够真正看到什么? 我们拆除了一个认知启发的生成循环 超过24个条件 在3个基本模型上。 其效果大多停留在一个操作中:一个新题材每几百个活字(中断)注入一流中,其字面重复被挡住(居住). 我们只判断生成的文本的窗口,其前提为单元(n=10)和一个衡量可重复性的法官,与第二个法官的家庭和人类读者相对. 根据这项协议,中断使判断的惊讶达到1.2至1.4分,仅习惯就增加了0.8分。 一个要求连续性的连接器会伤害人;一个光段落断接器不会增加新鲜文本上可探测的任何内容;一个重置的上下文至少是保存的上下文;在新房地上预先登记的复制件证实了主要对比。 有三件事 窗口法官无法看到 改变这个研究的第一个版本, 我们认为它们是通用的。 评委将实验员所注射的句子评为"模型自有". 注射句子的固定旋转使得模型从法官视野之外重放其前段,法官将重放评分为出乎意料和接通(中断后窗口的65-80%为150-300期). 而本地收益并不组成:没有分支产生综合文件. 显要显示器,入室裁判,内存横跨中断,由法官指定的评论跑出一个没有增加任何内容的门. 关于核查器(在线本包装)的问题,中断将有效、不同的候选休克量乘以三至四倍,而不提高最佳的质量。 我们报告一项长世代的评价协议,并报告对简单干预而不是创造性机制的有控制的定性。

articles.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
articles.content: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. To alleviate the engineering burden of rebuilding environments from scratch, we propose Environment Harness (EnvHarness), a programmable layer of plug-in components that wraps a static environment to reshape its behavior without modifying the underlying logic. Operating through standard interfaces, EnvHarness applies across diverse domains while ensuring every reshaped environment retains its original verifier. To automate this process, we introduce EnvRigger, which treats the target policy as a black box, observing its execution trajectories to synthesize EnvHarness components targeting diagnosed flaws, and validating them via fresh rollouts. Across five benchmarks in four domains, EnvHarness outperforms both original environments and domain-specific environment generation pipelines, achieving up to a 9.0-point improvement on held-out instances with 9.8% fewer execution steps. Furthermore, EnvHarness provides a superior optimization signal for reinforcement learning, enabling continuous, targeted co-evolution of the policy and its environment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EnvHarness:醒来静态世界为代理学习服务
articles.content_zh: LLM剂通过与环境的相互作用来学习,然而这些环境是手造而静态的:对一剂的弱点视而不见,随着它的改善而迅速被留下. 虽然最近的环境生成方法试图解决这一问题,但它们需要针对特定领域的管道,依赖昂贵或不可靠的核查器,并且仍然产生静态环境。 为了减轻从零开始重建环境的工程负担,我们提议环境哈内斯(EnvHarness),一个可编程的插件组件层,将静态环境包裹起来来重塑其行为而无需修改所基于的逻辑. 通过标准接口操作,EnvHarness适用于不同的领域,同时确保每个被重塑的环境保留了原来的验证器. 为了实现这一过程的自动化,我们引入了EnvRigger,它将目标政策作为黑匣子来对待,观察其执行轨迹来合成EnvHarness组件以锁定被诊断出缺陷,并通过新的推出来验证. 在4个领域的5个基准中,EnvHarness在原始环境和特定域的环境生成管道方面都超过了业绩,在搁置的情况下取得了9.0分的改进,执行步骤减少了9.8%。 此外,EnvHarness为强化学习提供了优异的优化信号,使得政策及其环境能够持续、有针对性地共同演变。

articles.title: A knowledge-guided agentic framework for mitigating patient-context ambiguity in health queries
articles.content: Patients often submit short, underspecified queries to healthcare chatbots that lack the patient-specific information needed to determine an appropriate response. Although these queries may be linguistically clear, they can support multiple plausible answers depending on undisclosed factors such as symptoms, diagnoses, medications, allergies, or dietary restrictions. A language model answering such a query directly may therefore rely on unsupported assumptions about the patient. We introduce a knowledge-guided agentic framework for mitigating patient-context ambiguity before final response generation. The framework operates between the patient and an otherwise unchanged downstream language model. It interprets the initial query, uses a task-specific knowledge graph to construct a set of plausible hypotheses, identifies the missing patient-context variables needed to distinguish among them, and asks targeted follow-up questions. The original query and the acquired context are then combined into a clarified prompt for the downstream model. We evaluated the framework across five language models using two controlled ambiguity-mitigation benchmarks: diagnosis retrieval from 1,034 symptom queries with clinically relevant evidence systematically masked, and dietary-safety classification from 487 queries with decisive health context omitted. The framework was compared with direct answering of the underspecified query and with rephrasing the same query without acquiring new patient information. In diagnosis retrieval, it increased overall exact Top-1 accuracy by at least 57.1 percentage points and selective exact Recall@5 by at least 77.7 percentage points across the five evaluated models compared with direct prompting. In dietary-safety classification, it improved accuracy across all five models and achieved the highest Matthews correlation coefficient for four...

articles.title_zh: 以知识为指南的媒介框架,以缓解患者在健康询问中的内容模糊不清
articles.content_zh: 患者往往向缺乏确定适当反应所需的特定患者信息的保健聊天员提出简短、不够明确的询问。 虽然这些询问在语言上可能很明确,但可以根据症状、诊断、药物、过敏或饮食限制等未公开的因素,支持多种可能的答复。 因此,直接回答这种询问的语言模型可能依赖于对患者的不支持的假设. 我们引入了一个知识指导剂框架,在最终反应产生之前减轻病人-背景模糊。 该框架在病人和未改变的下游语言模式之间运作。 它解释最初的查询,使用一个任务特定的知识图来构建一套可信的假设,找出缺少的病人-背景变量来区分它们,并询问有针对性的后续问题. 然后将原始查询和获得的上下文合并成澄清的下游模型的快取. 我们利用两个可控制的减轻模糊性基准,对5个语言模型的框架进行了评估:从1,034个症状查询中进行诊断检索,同时系统地掩盖临床相关证据;从487个有决定性健康背景的查询中进行饮食安全分类。 将框架与直接回答未指定的查询和重写相同的查询进行比较,而不获得新的病人信息。 在诊断检索方面,在五个评估模型中,它使总体精确度Top-1至少提高了57.1个百分点,选择性精确度Recall@5至少提高了77.7个百分点,而直接提示则提高了。 在饮食安全分类中,它提高了所有5个模型的精度,实现了4个最高的马修斯相关系数. .

articles.title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
articles.content: Customer-service LLM agents must follow organizational policy when acting on a user's behalf. Compliance failures arise from either forbidden actions, such as granting an ineligible change, or omitted procedural requirements, such as identification or confirmation. Runtime safeguards can intervene on risky actions, but action-local checks do not guide an agent through a multi-step procedure. Workflow-following systems support prescribed process execution, but primarily target workflow completion rather than safeguarding agent behavior. PolicyGuide instead compiles each domain policy into a workflow graph and invokes a proactive verifier at user-turn boundaries. From persisted graph state, the verifier reconciles open requests and returns step-specific remediation along a policy-compliant path. Across the $τ^2$-bench airline, retail, and telecom domains with a GPT-5.4 agent and verifier, PolicyGuide raises mean $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ from $0.42$ to $0.62$, with the largest gain on telecom ($0.19$ to $0.61$), the most workflow-structured domain. The same workflows transfer to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Pro agents. Complementary evaluations find the lowest observed attack-success rate under adversarial users and the strongest procedural compliance in an author-designed workflow-level validation.

articles.title_zh: 政策指南:从守护一个行动到指导整个工作流程 -- -- 公司LLM 探员
articles.content_zh: 客户服务 LLM代理商在代表用户行事时必须遵循组织政策. 不遵守规定的原因要么是被禁止的行动,如批准不合格的更改,要么是省略了程序要求,如身份识别或确认。 运行时间保障可以干预有风险的行动,但行动当地检查并不能通过多步骤程序指导代理人. 工作流程跟踪系统支持规定的流程执行,但主要是针对工作流程完成,而不是保障代理行为. 取而代之的是"政策指南"将每个域政策汇编成一个工作流程图,并在用户-回合边界上引用一个主动的验证符. 从持续的图表状态来看,核查者按照符合政策的路径调节开放请求并返回特定步骤的补救。 在拥有GPT-5.4代理和核查器的2美元平方圆的航空公司、零售和电信领域,《政策指南》将平均0.3美元从0.42美元提高到0.62美元,其中电信收益最大(0.19美元到0.61美元),是工作流程结构最强的领域。 相同的工作流程转移到克洛德·索内 4.6和双子座2.5 Pro代理. 补充评价发现,在对抗性用户中,观察到的攻击成功率最低,在作者设计的工作流程一级验证中,程序合规率最高。

articles.title: Towards Clinically Faithful Medical Image Captioning via Enhanced Vision-Language Alignment
articles.content: Medical image captioning is a technique that accelerates early-stage diagnostic workflows and enhances the interpretability of medical diagnostic AI systems. However, unlike general image captioning, clinically reliable captioning remains challenging due to grayscale-based modalities, subtle anatomical cues, specialized medical phrasing, and variations in data quality. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models, fluent outputs do not necessarily guarantee sufficient alignment with clinical concept spaces or evaluation criteria. To address this issue, we propose a framework that strengthens clinical alignment by separating and enhancing training-time alignment and inference-time alignment. We build a medical image captioning pipeline that integrates single/dual vision encoders based on BioMedCLIP and SigLIP2, a Q-Former, and a LLaMA-based decoder, and examine the contribution of auxiliary learning for UMLS concept/type prediction. At inference, we apply single-embedding-based reranking to select the best caption among candidates, while at training we introduce MedPAIR-SCST, which combines clinically relevant rewards to shift the generative distribution toward improved clinical alignment. Our experiments show that complementary visual representations with a multi-encoder design and concept-level auxiliary learning help preserve clinically meaningful information. Furthermore, inference-time reranking provides a practical way to improve semantic and clinical alignment without additional training, whereas MedPAIR-SCST goes beyond selection by directly improving the model's distribution to generate more consistent and clinically grounded captions. These findings suggest that jointly leveraging selection-based alignment and reinforcement-learning-based alignment can promote more trustworthy medical image captioning even in data-constrained settings.

articles.title_zh: 通过增强视野-语言对齐实现临床上忠贞的医学形象说明
articles.content_zh: 医学影像字幕是一种加速早期诊断工作流程,增强医学诊断AI系统的可解释性的技术. 然而,与一般图像标题不同,临床上可靠的标题仍然具有挑战性,原因是基于灰色尺度的模式、微妙的解剖提示、专门的医学措辞和数据质量的差异。 尽管最近在大型视觉语言模型方面取得了进展,但流利的产出不一定能保证充分符合临床概念空间或评价标准。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一个框架,通过分离和加强培训时间调整和推断时间调整来加强临床调整。 我们建造一个医疗图像字幕管道,将基于BioMedCLIP和SigLIP2的单/双视觉编码器整合起来,一个Q-Former和一个基于LLaMA的解码器,并检查辅助学习对UMLS概念/类型预测的贡献. 推论一下,我们采用基于单嵌的重新排序,在考生中选择最佳的字幕,而在培训时,我们引入了MedPAIR-SCST,它结合了临床相关的奖励,将基因分配转向更好的临床调整。 我们的实验表明,用多编码器设计和概念级辅助学习补充视觉表现有助于保存临床上有意义的信息。 此外,重排推断时间为在没有额外培训的情况下改进语义和临床对齐提供了实用方法,而MedPAIR-SCST则超越选择范围,直接改进模型的分布,生成更加一致和基于临床的说明。 这些调查结果表明,联合利用基于选择的调整和基于强化的学习的调整,即使在数据受限制的环境中也能促进更可信的医疗图像字幕。

articles.title: MileGPO: Milestone Inference with Local Evidence for Graph-Based Policy Optimization of Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.content: Credit assignment is challenging in long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning, where supervision often comes only from final rewards. Existing methods refine trajectory-level signals into step-level credits through step grouping or graph-based advantage estimation, but can overlook meaningful intermediate milestones. We propose MileGPO (Milestone Inference with Local Evidence for Graph-Based Policy Optimization), which derives process-level credit from grouped on-policy rollouts through three designs. Milestone Discovery identifies candidate milestones on successful rollouts and recurring traps on failed ones. Reliability-Calibrated Shaping (RCS) weights these candidates by outcome-based confidence, strengthening reliable milestones and traps while down-weighting uncertain ones. Progress-Contrastive Calibration (PCC) further tests whether a candidate reflects local progress and whether its incoming ansition outperforms observed alternatives from the same state.MileGPO requires neither auxiliary models nor additional environment interaction. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show state-of-the-art performance and a small in-distribution to out-of-distribution gap on ALFWorld. Ablations and credit diagnostics indicate that reliability weighting, local progress, and same-state branch evidence complement milestone discovery and resolve ambiguous intermediate credit.

articles.title_zh: MileGPO:用地表证据推论,优化长视线LLM 探员
articles.content_zh: 在长期代理强化学习中,信用分配具有挑战性,因为监督往往只来自最后奖励。 现有方法通过分步分组或以图表为基础的优势估计,将轨迹级信号改进为分步级入计量,但可以忽略有意义的中间里程碑。 我们提出MileGPO(Milestone 推论当地证据,以图为基础的政策优化),通过三个设计,从分组政策推出中获得流程一级的信用。 里程碑发现组织确定了成功推出的候选里程碑和失败者反复出现的陷阱。 通过基于结果的信心来对这些候选人进行衡量,加强可靠的里程碑和陷阱,同时减少不确定因素的加权。 进步-连通性校正(PCC)进一步测试候选人是否反映当地的进展,以及其即将到来的阳具是否超过同一状态的替代品。 MileGPO既不需要辅助模型,也不需要额外的环境相互作用. 在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验显示最新性能,并在ALFWorld上小幅分出出分出差距. 扣分和信用诊断表明,可靠性权重、当地进展和同状态分支的证据补充了里程碑式的发现并解决了模棱两可的中间信用。

articles.title: Stopping and Routing LLM Judge Panels
articles.content: LLM evaluation pipelines often have many candidate judges: general LLM-as-a-judge prompts, reward models, safety classifiers, confidence variants, and task-specific verifiers. The deployment question is not only which judge is best, but which judges should be called, on which examples, and when panel construction should stop. We formulate judge-panel design as a role-conditioned allocation problem. From a small labeled audit set, declared slices, and judge costs, the method estimates target-relative roles: copies add no conditional information, complements improve the global panel, and specialists help only on slices. These roles induce a policy: drop copies, add complements globally, route specialists conditionally, and stop when validation gain falls below a threshold. Across reasoning, code, safety, preference, reward-model, summarization, and math audits, the method is compared with single judges, flat panels, matched diversity heuristics, full-call stacking, reliability juries, and frugal cascades. The result is a regime map for judge calls: route specialists on deployable slices, stop in saturated verifier regimes, keep broad ensembles when their risk benefit is worth the cost, and ignore conditional copies. The output is a reusable, auditable call plan for the next evaluation batch.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 停止和运行LLM法官小组
articles.content_zh: LLM评价管道往往有许多候选法官:一般LLM-as-a-judge points,奖励模型,安全分类器,信心变体,以及任务特定验证器. 部署问题不仅在于哪一个法官是最佳的,而且应该请哪个法官、哪些例子以及何时应停止小组建设。 我们制定法官小组的设计,作为角色分配问题。 从一个被贴上标签的小型审计集,申报的切片,以及判断成本,该方法估计目标相对作用:副本不添加有条件的信息,补充改进全球面板,专家只帮助切片. 这些角色诱导着一种政策:减少复制件,增加全球补充,有条件的路由专家,当验证所得低于门槛时停止. 在推理、代码、安全、偏好、奖励模式、总结和数学审计等方面,该方法与单一法官、平板法官、多样性高压法官、全称堆放、可靠性陪审团和节俭级联进行了比较。 结果是法官调用的制度图:可部署片的路线专家,停止饱和的核查制度,在风险收益值成本时保持广泛的综艺,并忽略有条件的复制。 产出是下一批评价的可重复使用、可审计的调用计划。

articles.title: LoRA-GA$^2$: Low Rank Adaptation with Multi-step Gradient Adaptive Alignment
articles.content: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a prominent fine-tuning method for large models, achieving competitive performance with reduced memory overhead. However, a persistent performance gap remains between LoRA and full fine-tuning. Recent studies have sought to narrow this gap by employing one-step gradient approximations of pretrained weights to align LoRA updates with the principal directions or intrinsic dimensionalities of full fine-tuning updates. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to capture the full dynamics of the gradients. In this paper, we propose LoRA-GA$^2$, an effective fine-tuning algorithm that fully leverages multi-step gradient information. Specifically, we introduce a lightweight probe for multi-step gradients of pretrained weights that incurs no additional GPU memory cost and only marginal time overhead. We further employ a spectrum-aware, importance-based rank allocation and optimal initialization derived from multi-step gradients. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that LoRA-GA$^2$ consistently outperforms existing LoRA variants while preserving the efficiency advantages of vanilla LoRA. For instance, LoRA-GA$^2$ surpasses the leading baseline by an average of 0.66 points on the GLUE benchmark, and outperforms the strongest baseline by 1.03 points on GSM8K and 0.87 points on HumanEval, respectively.

articles.title_zh: LoRA-GA$^2$: 低等适应多步适应
articles.content_zh: Low-Rank Adaptation(LORA)是大型模型的一种突出的微调方法,通过降低内存间接费用实现有竞争力的性能. 然而,在LORA和全面微调之间仍然存在持续的业绩差距。 最近的研究试图缩小这一差距,采用预先训练的权重的一步梯度近似,使LORA更新与全面微调更新的主要方向或内在维度一致. 然而,这些方法未能充分反映梯度的动态。 在本文中,我们提出LORA-GA$^2$,这是一种有效的微调算法,充分利用多步梯度信息. 具体来说,我们引入了一种轻量级探测器,用于预受训练重量的多步梯度,这种梯度不需要额外的GPU内存成本,也只需要边际时间的管理费. 我们还利用多步骤梯度产生的具有频谱意识、基于重要性的分级和优化初始化。 广泛的实验结果表明,LORA-GA$^2美元在保持香草LORA的效率优势的同时,一贯优于现有的LORA变体。 例如,LORA-GA$^2美元在GLUE基准上平均超过领先基准0.66分,在GSM8K和HumanEval上分别超过最强基准1.03分和0.87分。

articles.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
articles.content: Software increasingly functions as part of the scientific instrument itself, making failures in scientific code capable of compromising not only program behavior but also the evidence underlying scientific conclusions. Yet existing evaluations of coding agents largely emphasize aggregate task success, providing limited insight into why agents fail when repairing scientific software. We introduce \textbf{SWE-bench Science}, a repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering comprising 119 tasks from 98 GitHub repositories across 20 scientific domains. Each task is organized into one of three paradigms: Issue-driven, Expert-exploratory, and Engineering-integration. Even the best-performing agent, \textbf{Claude Code with Opus-5 (max), achieves a pass@1 below 50\%}, highlighting the substantial challenges posed by scientific software engineering. We identify four recurring failure mechanisms: deficits in scientific knowledge or abstraction, misguided exploration or surface-level repair, incomplete repair coverage or system integration, and failures to generalize scientific knowledge beyond observed cases in our analysis. We further conduct a paired ablation that removes explicit scientific guidance while preserving the repository and executable engineering context. The results show that scientific knowledge is not uniformly beneficial: well-grounded information can constrain repair and improve average performance and token efficiency, whereas poorly aligned guidance can induce anchoring and does not necessarily improve exact repair success. Together, SWE-bench Science provides a broad testbed for studying both the capabilities and failure mechanisms of coding agents in scientific software engineering.

articles.title_zh: SWE-bench Science:编码代理能够解决科学领域的工程任务吗?.
articles.content_zh: 软件日益发挥作为科学仪器本身的一部分的功能,使得科学代码的失败不仅能够损害程序行为,而且能够损害科学结论背后的证据. 然而,对编码剂的现有评价主要强调总体任务的成功,对制剂在修复科学软件时失败的原因提供有限的认识。 我们引入\textbf{SWE-bench Science},这是科学软件工程的存储器级基准,包含来自98个GitHub存储器的119个任务,涵盖20个科学领域。 每项任务分为三个范式之一:问题驱动、专家探索和工程一体化。 甚至表现最好的代理\textbf{ Claude Code with Opus-5 (max),也实现了50-Q以下的通取@1,突出了科学软件工程带来的巨大挑战. 我们找出了四种反复出现的失败机制:科学知识或抽象不足、误入歧途的勘探或地表一级修理、不完全的修理覆盖或系统整合,以及我们的分析未能将科学知识概括于所观察到的情况之外。 我们进一步进行一对结合,取消明确的科学指导,同时保留储存库和可执行工程的背景。 结果显示,科学知识并非一致有益:有根据的信息可以限制修理,提高平均性能和象征性效率,而不协调的指导则可以诱发锚地,不一定能改进准确的修理成功。 SWE-bench Science共同为研究科学软件工程中编码剂的能力和故障机制提供了广泛的试验床.

articles.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay
articles.content: Audited against causal ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals used to train LLM agents -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- identifies which steps causally matter better than chance. Existing evaluations grade these signals against annotated step *correctness*; we audit them against step *contribution* -- what re-sampling the policy's own alternatives at each decision point and rolling forward actually changes about the outcome -- and the two come apart. The ground truth itself is structured: causal contribution is sparse (30.5% of decision points where ground truth is defined carry measurable effect), and measurability is model-dependent -- the fraction of points with no policy-supported counterfactual differs by a factor of two (13.1% vs. 26.8%) between two similar-scale policies. The failure mode is identifiable: implicit credit echoes the policy's fluency (median rank correlation +0.75, replicating at +0.70 in a second family under a corrected instrument), while conditioning on the outcome adds no causal information (partial correlation -0.004, Qwen). A confidence-only router recovers pivotal steps at chance level, but cuts judge cost by 13.1% per turn (14.0% per trajectory). In a seven-arm pre-registered training experiment, no arm reliably outperforms the untrained policy, and the checkpoints' apparent instrument signature is fully explained by training dose -- sparser credit retains fewer examples, an order-of-magnitude spread in optimizer steps -- not credit content. Comparisons of credit rules must therefore match effective sample size, or they measure dose, not credit.

articles.title_zh: 无地信用:针对被执行的重放, LLM 代理中的审计阶梯级信用任务
articles.content_zh: 根据在单一代理工具环境(ALFWorld)中被执行的再播放的因果地面真相进行审计,用于培训LLM代理商的阶梯级信用信号中,没有任何一个 -- -- LLM 判断分数,结果有条件的对数比,或者政策本身的信心 -- -- 确定哪些因果比机会更好。 现有评价根据附加说明的步 * 正确性* 对这些信号进行分级;我们对照步 * 贡献* 对这些信号进行审核 -- -- 在每个决策点对政策本身的可选方案进行再抽样,然后在结果上进行滚动,两者就发生了实际变化 -- -- 而两者则相去甚远。 地面真理本身是结构化的:因果贡献很少(定义地面真理的决定点的30.5%具有可衡量效果),可衡量性依赖模型 -- -- 没有政策支持的反事实的分点因两个类似规模政策之间的两个因素(13.1%对26.8%)而异。 失败模式可以识别:隐含的信用呼应了保单的流利性(中间排名关联+0.75,在被修正的仪器下在第二个家族中以+0.70复制),而对结果的限定不会增加因果关系(部分关联-0.004,Quen). 唯一信任的路由器在机会水平上恢复了关键步骤,但法官每转弯成本为13.1%(每道轨迹为14.0%)。 在7个武器预先登记的训练试验中,没有任何武器可靠地超过未受过训练的政策,检查站的明显仪器签字完全由训练剂量来解释 -- -- 较少的功劳保留了较少的例子,这是在最优化的步骤中的一种宽度分布,而不是信用内容。 因此,信用规则的比较必须与有效样本大小相匹配,或衡量剂量,而不是信用。

articles.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
articles.content: Long-context modeling is a pivotal capability for Large Language Models, yet the quadratic complexity of attention remains a critical bottleneck, particularly during the compute-intensive prefilling phase. Our previous work, FlashPrefill, mitigates this cost through instantaneous pattern discovery and max-based dynamic thresholding; however, it remains an algorithmic prototype that is still distant from production deployment. In this paper, we present FlashPrefill V2, which evolves FlashPrefill from a prototype toward practical long-context serving along three dimensions. First, we introduce a mean correction term that effectively suppresses the approximation error, keeping performance degradation manageable even at extreme sparsity levels. Second, we redesign the sparse attention operator with PackGQA memory access, warp specialization, and pingpong pipelining, fully aligning with the latest FlashAttention-3/4 implementations and supporting FP8 inference to meet practical quantization requirements. Third, FlashPrefill V2 natively supports paged KV cache and continuous batching, allowing integration as an attention backend in modern inference frameworks such as SGLang. Extensive evaluations on NVIDIA H20 GPUs---among the most widely deployed inference accelerators---demonstrate that FlashPrefill V2 delivers up to 47.26x and 27.19x speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 128K context length under FP8 and BF16 precision, respectively, and, in FP8, still achieves a 30.49x speedup against an FA3/4-aligned dense baseline.

articles.title_zh: Flash Prefill V2: 长文本 LLM 的块- 分页预补注意 服务
articles.content_zh: 长文本模型是大语言模型的关键能力,然而关注的四重复杂性仍然是一个关键的瓶颈,特别是在计算密集的预填阶段. 我们以前的工作 -- -- FlashPrefill -- -- 通过即时模式发现和以最大值为基础的动态阈值来减轻这一成本;然而,它仍然是一个算法原型,仍然远离生产部署。 在本文中,我们介绍Flash Prefill V2,它将Flash Prefill从原型演化为实用的长文,服务于三个维度. 首先,我们引入了一个能有效抑制近似误差的平分校正术语,使性能降解即使在极端的痉挛水平上也能控制. 第二,我们重新设计了PackGQA内存存取、曲速专门化和乒乓管衬线的稀少的注意力操作器,与最新的FlashAttenty-3/4执行完全一致,并支持FP8推论,以满足实际的量化要求。 第三点 闪光 Prefill V2在本土上支持被页化的KV缓存和连续分批,允许集成为SGLang等现代推论框架中的注意后端. 对NVIDIA H20 GPU进行广泛的评价 -- -- 在FFP8和BF16精度下,FlashPrefill V2在FlashAttention-2上分别以128K的上下文长度提供高达47.26x和27.19x的快取,在FP8中仍能比FA3/4相通的密集基线达到30.49x快取.

articles.title: Truncate Bad, Upweight Good: BoN-Style Distillation via Rank-Based Classification
articles.content: Inference-time selection methods, such as Best-of-N, improve generation by sampling a pool of candidates and selecting the top-ranked completion according to a reward model. Distillation seeks to amortize this procedure into a single policy by replacing raw rewards with in-pool ranks and learning a policy that upweights higher-ranked completions. However, existing rank-based policies typically use smooth full-support reweighting, so low-ranked completions receive less mass but remain in the target support. Although a sharper reweighting reduces lower-tail mass, it also increases reliance on brittle ranking at the top made by a single reward model. We propose TUP: a Truncate-bad, Upweight-good Policy that removes low-ranked completions from the support and reweights only the retained upper tail with a tunable sharpness. TUP admits a closed-form, prompt-independent normalization and can be trained fully offline via binary cross-entropy, using shifted-truncated win-rates as soft labels and distilled-to-reference log-likelihood ratios as logits. Theoretically, under certain assumptions, we show that for any unknown oracle reward, the best monotone rank-reweighting can be matched by a lower-tail truncation rule, providing formal support for removing the lower tail rather than merely downweighting it. Empirically, we show that TUP is competitive with strong offline alignment baselines.

articles.title: PersonalBench: Measuring the Authorship Gap in LLM Personalization
articles.content: Personalized text generation aims to make LLMs write in a specific individual's style, yet existing benchmarks measure task accuracy or preference alignment rather than whether the model's output actually resembles the target author's writing. We introduce PersonalBench, a benchmark that evaluates inference-time personalization methods through three independent lenses: LUAR (a trained authorship verification model), an LLM-as-judge, and automated stylometrics. Across 50 authors, 1,000 generations, and two model families (Qwen 3, GLM-4), we find that personalization methods do produce author-differentiated output (LUAR discriminates target authors within generated text at AUC=0.918) but this differentiation never crosses the human-LLM boundary. All methods achieve LUAR similarity to real authors in the range 0.484-0.508, below the cross-author human floor of 0.626 (ceiling 0.756). The LLM's own authorship fingerprint dominates: generated text is more distant from any human author than random humans are from each other. Methods are statistically indistinguishable from each other on LUAR (spread 0.024) despite appearing differentiated on the LLM judge, a discrepancy we trace to circularity between trait extraction and profile extraction. We validate that LUAR reliably measures authorship in our corpus (AUC=0.76 single-post, 0.96 multi-post). We release PersonalBench as a calibrated measuring stick: inference-time personalization modulates the LLM's style but does not bridge the gap to human authorship.

articles.title_zh: Personal Bench:测量LLM个人化中作者差距
articles.content_zh: 个性化的文本生成旨在让LLMs以特定个人的风格来写作,然而现有的基准衡量任务精确度或偏好相接,而不是模型的输出是否实际上与目标作者的写作相类似. 我们引入了个人奔驰(Personal Bench),这个基准通过三个独立的透镜来评价推论-时间个性化方法:LUAR(一个训练有素的作者身份验证模型),LLM-as-judge,以及自动化的型号测量. 超过50位作者,1000代,以及两个模范家庭(Quen 3, GLM-4),我们发现个性化方法确实产生作者区分输出(LUAR在生成的文本中歧视目标作者,AUC=0.918),但这种区分从未跨越人-LLM边界. 所有方法都实现了LUAR与真实作者的相近性,在0.484-0.508之间,低于0.626的交叉作者人底(最高为0.756)。 LLM自己的作者身份指纹占据了主导地位:生成的文本与任何人类作者相比更相去甚远,而非随机的人类彼此相去甚远. 方法在统计学上无法区分LUAR(扩展为0.024),尽管LLM法官有区别,但我们追踪到特征提取和剖面提取之间的循环。 我们确认,LUAR可靠地衡量了我们书目中的作者身份(AUC=0.76个单帖,0.96个多帖)。 我们释放个人奔驰作为校正的测量棒:推论-个人化时间调制了LLM的风格,但并没有弥补与人类著作的鸿沟.

articles.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows
articles.content: Recent agent benchmarks increasingly ground evaluation in executable environments, from code repair to web navigation, app APIs, and function calling. Yet completing consequential work beyond code requires more than producing a plausible response or valid tool call: agents must gather missing information over multiple turns, follow domain policies, coordinate dependent tools, and realize the correct persistent state transition without collateral effects. In this paper, we introduce Thinkingbox, a sandbox for tool-agent-user interaction that provides isolated MCP-compatible tool sessions, complete execution traces, and outcome evaluation over terminal backend state. Built on this sandbox, Thinkingbox-bench contains 507 policy-conditioned workflows across numerous scenarios, including retail, hospitality, auto insurance, neobank internal IT, and consulting IT/HR support. Each attempt is evaluated by task-specific executable checks that accept valid trajectories while rejecting wrong, missing, or extra effects; designated tasks additionally check required properties of the final response. Across proprietary and open-weight models, the strongest achieves 65.36% pass@1, but only 25.25% pass^20. Moreover, many failed trials show clean termination and valid state-changing actions, showing that response or tool-call-level signals are not clear proxies for end-to-end task completion. Thinkingbox-bench reveals a large gap between occasionally finding a successful trajectory and reliably completing stateful business tasks. We release both Thinkingbox and Thinkingbox-Bench: https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox

articles.title_zh: " 一个成功不是可靠性:思考箱 " ,一个Sandbox和国有商业工作流程中的代理基准
articles.content_zh: 最近的代理基准越来越多地在可执行环境中进行地面评价,从代码修复到网络导航,应用API以及函数调用. 然而,完成超出代码范围的相应工作需要的不仅仅是产生一个可信的回应或有效的工具呼叫:代理商必须收集多个转折中缺失的信息,遵循域政策,协调依赖性工具,实现正确的持续状态过渡而不会附带影响. 在本文中,我们引入了 Thinkingbox,一个用于工具代理-用户交互的沙盒,它提供了孤立的MCP兼容工具会话,完整的执行痕迹,以及终端后端状态上的结果评价. 这个沙盒上,思明盒-平底有507个符合政策条件的工作流程,包括零售、招待、汽车保险、新银行内部信息技术和咨询IT/HR支助。 每次尝试都通过任务特定可执行性检查来评价,这些检查接受有效的轨迹,同时拒绝错误的,缺失的,或者额外的效果;指定的任务额外检查最终响应所需的属性. 在所有专有和开放重量模式中,最强者通过65.36%@1,但只有25.25%通过^20。 此外,许多失败的试验显示,彻底终止和有效改变状态的行动,表明答复或工具呼叫级别信号不是完成端到端任务的明确代名词. 思考箱-bench揭示了偶尔找到成功轨迹和可靠地完成状态商业任务之间的巨大差距. 我们发行了思维盒和思维盒-奔驰:https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox

articles.title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attack against Large Vision-Language Models via Subtitle Scheduling
articles.content: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding and reasoning. Despite extensive studies on text- and image-based jailbreaks, video jailbreaks against LVLMs remain largely unexplored. Existing video jailbreak methods mainly manipulate textual content embedded in videos, while overlooking how such information is organized over time. Our analysis reveals that jailbreak effectiveness depends not only on the semantics of textual information but also on its temporal presentation, including duration and timing-slot allocation. Motivated by this finding, we use subtitles, which are common in real-world videos and allow semantic content to be presented under precise temporal control without appearing visually intrusive, as a natural attack medium. Based on this insight, we propose TempJail, a black-box video-based jailbreak framework that constructs query-aligned dialogue-style subtitle sequences and optimizes their temporal scheduling to exploit temporal vulnerabilities in LVLMs and elicit responses that satisfy the harmful intent of the source query. Extensive experiments on four representative LVLMs and two datasets demonstrate that TempJail achieves the highest attack success rate across all evaluated model--dataset settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 53 and 18 percentage points in dataset-averaged ASR on GPT-5 and Gemini 3.5-Flash, respectively.

articles.title_zh: Templail:通过字幕日程安排攻击大型视觉-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)在视频理解和推理方面取得了显著进展. 尽管对基于文字和图像的越狱事件进行了广泛的研究,但针对LVLMs的越狱视频仍然基本上没有得到探讨。 现有的视频越狱方法主要操控嵌入到视频中的文字内容,同时俯瞰这些信息如何在一段时间内组织起来. 我们的分析表明,破狱的有效性不仅取决于文字信息的语义,还取决于其时间表述,包括时间和时间分配。 基于这一发现,我们使用字幕,这些字幕在现实世界的视频中很常见,并允许语义内容在精确的时间控制下呈现,而不出现视觉侵扰,作为自然攻击媒介. 基于这种洞察力,我们提议TempJail,这是一个黑盒基于视频的越狱框架,它构建出查询相通的对话式字幕序列并优化其时间时间安排,以利用LVLMs中的时间弱点并获得满足源查询有害意图的响应. 对四个具有代表性的LVLM和两个数据集的广泛实验表明,TempJail在所有被评价的模型-数据集设置中都取得了最高的攻击成功率,在GPT-5和双子座3.5-Flash的数据集平均ASR中,表现分别比最强的基准高出了53和18个百分点.

articles.title: Projector Is All You Train
articles.content: The typical training process of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) involves adapting both the language model backbone and the projector between the backbone and a modality-specific encoder. We ask whether fine-tuning the backbone of an MLLM is necessary to adapt it to a new modality. Through experiments on 3D MLLMs, we find that training only the projector is sufficient to achieve strong multimodal performance relative to existing baseline models and our jointly trained MLLMs with the same encoder and backbone. We also show that joint training leads to undesirable drift in existing capabilities of the language model, which projector-only training avoids by definition. Furthermore, projector-only training has approximately twice the training sample throughput of joint training. We validate our findings across different language model backbones via 3D classification and captioning benchmarks as well as standard benchmarks evaluating language, vision, and spatial reasoning capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 投影仪是全部您列车
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLM)的典型培训过程涉及在主干和特定模式编码器之间调整语言模型主干和投影仪。 我们问,是否需要对最低劳动标准的主干线进行微调,使之适应新的模式。 通过对3D MLLMs的实验,我们发现,仅培训投影仪就足以实现与现有基准模型和我们用同样的编码器和主干线共同培训的MLLMs相比的强大的多式性能. 我们还表明,联合培训导致语文模式现有能力出现不可取的偏差,而只有语言模式的培训顾名思义地避免了这种偏差。 此外,只有投影员的培训大约是联合培训培训的两倍。 我们通过三维分类和字幕基准以及评估语言、远景和空间推理能力的标准基准,验证我们在不同语言模型主干网中的调查结果。

articles.title: StreamSoccer: Event-Driven Memory for Streaming Soccer Commentary
articles.content: Streaming video understanding requires models to causally update state as video arrives and organize growing history into semantic units that can evolve, persist, and be recalled under bounded computation and memory. This challenge is pronounced in live soccer commentary, where a system must describe completed events, summarize recent play, recall earlier events, or remain silent using only information available before each utterance. We present StreamSoccer, an event-driven system that uses event memory as its intermediate representation. A fixed-budget active memory integrates the stream; completed event states are retained locally and consolidated into retrievable historical records. A unified generator uses current, recent, and historical context to produce three commentary modes, while a rule-assisted scheduler selects a mode or silence. Unlike streaming video-language models organized around frames, visual tokens, or caches, and soccer-commentary methods based on predefined clips or output timestamps, StreamSoccer explicitly models event lifecycles. We construct a three-track streaming soccer commentary dataset and a layered evaluation protocol. At common reference anchors, StreamSoccer obtains CIDEr scores of 38.62, 23.96, and 17.39 for current-event, recent-window, and historical-memory commentary, ranking first on the current-event and historical-memory tracks and second on recent-window. Controlled ablations show that local completed events improve all tracks and that the full system performs best on all three. Across 174 raw-video runs on 58 matches, per-minute RTF p95 ranges from 0.10 to 0.22 without sustained growth with match history. These results indicate that event memory supports streaming soccer commentary across temporal scopes while controlling long-history computation.

articles.title_zh: 流球赛: 流出足球评论事件驱动记忆
articles.content_zh: 将视频理解流化需要模型在视频到来时因果更新状态,并将不断增长的历史组织成语义单位,这些单位可以进化,持续,并在受约束的计算和内存下被召回. 这一挑战在现场足球评论中被宣告出来,在这个评论中,一个系统必须描述已完成的事件,总结最近的事件,回顾以前的事件,或者只使用每次发言之前掌握的信息保持沉默。 我们介绍StreamSoccer,一种由事件驱动的系统,它使用事件记忆作为其中间代表. 固定预算活性内存集成流;完成的事件状态在当地保留并被整合为可检索的历史记录. 一个统一的生成器使用当前,最近,和历史的上下文来生成三种评注模式,而规则辅助调度器则选择一种模式或沉默. 与流线视频语言模型围绕帧,可视化符,或缓存组织,以及基于预定义剪辑或输出时间戳的足球辅助方法不同,流线足球明确模型事件生命周期. 我们构建了三轨流式足球评论数据集和分层评价协议. 在常见的参考主播中,StreamSoccer获得CIDER分数38.62分,23.96分和17.39分,为当下事件,近事窗口和历史记忆评论,在当下事件和历史记忆轨道上排名第一,在近事窗口上排名第二. 控制下的活动显示,当地完成的活动改进了所有轨道,整个系统在所有三个轨道上表现最好。 超过174个原始视频运行在58个火柴上,每分钟RTFp95从0.10到0.22不等,没有匹配历史的持续增长. 这些结果表明,事件记忆支持跨时间范围流传的足球评论,同时控制了长历史的计算.

articles.title: The Asymmetric Harms of LLM Compression
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) compression reduces deployment costs, but standard aggregate metrics like perplexity and accuracy often mask underlying behavioral shifts. In this work, we systematically evaluate 3 LLMs across 11 compression methods to investigate the effects of compression on knowledge retention, model confidence, and social bias. We find that compression disproportionately reduces the relative retention of head knowledge compared to tail knowledge. Furthermore, compressed models often remain substantially confident in their incorrect answers on newly lost knowledge. Finally, we demonstrate that stable aggregate bias scores can conceal substantial, opposing shifts in stereotypical preferences across demographic subgroups. Together, these findings reveal asymmetric behavioral changes that aggregate performance measures fail to capture, highlighting the need for granular evaluation of compressed models before deployment.

articles.title_zh: LLM 压缩的不对称伤害
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)压缩可以降低部署成本,但诸如迷惑和精度等标准聚合度量往往会掩盖基础的行为转变. 在这部作品中,我们系统评价了3个LLM,涵盖11个压缩方法,以调查压缩对知识保存,模型自信和社会偏见的影响. 我们发现,与尾翼知识相比,压缩不成比例地减少了头部知识的相对保留. 此外,压缩模型往往对新丢失知识的不正确答案保持高度信心。 最后,我们表明,稳定的累计偏差得分可以掩盖人口分组之间陈规定型偏好的重大、对立的转变。 这些调查结果共同揭示出不对称的行为变化,综合业绩计量无法捕捉,突出表明在部署之前需要对压缩模型进行颗粒评价.

articles.title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
articles.content: Agentic language models repeatedly encode tool and skill schemas that recur across requests in different combinations and orders, preventing standard prefix caching from reusing their key--value (KV) states. We introduce \textbf{ReCache}, a framework for independently caching resource representations while reducing their inference-time computational and memory overhead. Resource-wise attention removes cross-resource interactions and assigns resource-local positions, producing composition-invariant KV blocks. ReCache then restricts resource visibility to contribution-selected layer--KV-head-group routes and retains only invocation-critical fields through structural and semantic pruning. We evaluate ReCache on a benchmark assembled from seven public tool- and skill-use datasets, including resource-disjoint tests. Resource-wise attention matches dense invocation performance (82.3\% versus 82.4\% Inv-F1) while providing a 3.655$\times$ time-to-first-token speedup. The complete framework reduces allocated KV-tensor memory by 92.43\% and accelerates attention by 1.423$\times$. These results show that separating reusable schema encoding from selective resource access substantially reduces agentic inference costs with limited effectiveness loss. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/ReCache.

articles.title_zh: 补卡: 高效 KV 工具强化 LLM 缓存重用和压缩 探员
articles.content_zh: 代理语言模型反复地编码工具和技能计划,在不同组合和命令中在请求中重复出现,防止了标准前缀的字符串重用其键值(KV)状态. 我们引入\textbf{ReCache},这是一个独立缓存资源表达的框架,同时减少其推断时间的计算和内存管理费。 以资源为导向的注意可以去除跨资源相互作用,并指定资源-局部位置,产生成分-变化性的KV块. ReCache随后将资源能见度限制在贡献所选的层-KV头组路由上,并仅保留通过结构和语义穿行的引用关键字段. 我们对ReCache进行了评估,其基准是从7个公共工具和技能使用数据集,包括资源不相干测试汇集而成。 资源导向的注意与密集引用性能相匹配(82.3\%对82.4\%Inv-F1),同时提供3.655美元\times$时间到第一键的加速. 完整的框架将分配的KV-tensor内存减少92.43\%并加速关注1.423美元\times$. 这些结果表明,将可再利用的系统编码与选择性资源存取分开,大大减少了代理推导成本,并减少了有限的效能损失。 该代码可见于https://github.com/EIT-NLP/ReCache.

articles.title: Can Agent Memory Systems Track Evolving State?
articles.content: As LLM-based agents are deployed for longer and higher-stakes tasks, their memory systems continue to have crucial gaps. While existing memory benchmarks focus largely on recall-shaped tasks, we argue an effective memory system must track the evolving state of the world; as facts, constraints, and decisions are revised over a long interaction, answers must reflect the current state and not a superseded one. We define this capability as state tracking and instantiate it in StateMemBench, a benchmark of 234 multi-session scenarios spanning two conversation-length regimes. Its closed-pool grading scores whether an answer reflects the current state, the superseded state, or fails otherwise, separating state-tracking failures from other errors by construction. Our analysis shows that this task is challenging for existing memory systems, retrieval-augmented baselines, and long-context baselines. We then present StateMem, a state-first memory method that explicitly tracks supersession and relational dependencies, and show it improves current-state accuracy over the strongest same-backbone baseline by 1.8x (0.205 -> 0.363) on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and over the strongest memory system by 1.6x (0.149 -> 0.233) on Qwen-3.5-9B, while remaining competitive with the long-context baselines. Finally, we show the same state approach can be applied as a lightweight single-call wrapper over existing memory systems, lifting current-state accuracy by +32 to +67 points on StateMemBench across six memory and retrieval backends. A length- and cost-matched control attributes +15 to +32 of those points to state structure rather than added context.

articles.title_zh: 代理内存系统能追踪进化状态吗 ?
articles.content_zh: 由于基于LLM的代理被部署在更长和更高级的任务中,他们的内存系统仍然有关键的漏洞. 虽然现有的记忆基准主要侧重于召回形状的任务,但我们主张有效的记忆系统必须跟踪世界不断变化的状况;由于事实、制约和决定通过长期互动加以修订,答案必须反映目前的状况,而不是被取代的状况。 我们把这种能力定义为状态跟踪,并在国家梅姆本奇(State Mem Bench)进行即时跟踪,该基准由234个跨两个对话周期的多会场情景构成。 它的闭合集合分数是反映当前状态,被取代状态,还是以其他方式失败,通过构建将状态跟踪失败与其他错误区分开来. 我们的分析表明,这项任务对现有内存系统、检索强化基线和长文本基线具有挑战性。 然后,我们介绍StateMem,一种状态第一内存方法,它明确跟踪超会话和关系依赖性,并显示它在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上比最强同背骨基线提高1.8x(0.205 - > 0.363)和在Quen-3.5-9B上比最强内存系统提高1.6x(0.149 - > 0.233)的当前状态精度,同时保持对长文基线的竞争力. 最后,我们显示同样的状态方法可以作为轻量级单调收发包来被应用在现有内存系统之上,将当前状态的精度由"SnationMem Bench"在"SnationMem Bench"上以+32至+67分提升到6个内存并取回后端. 长度和成本匹配的控制属性+15到+32,这些点指向状态结构,而不是添加上下文.
